title: Collapsed glacier likely caused devastating Nepal-Tibet floods, scientists say
english: Scientists have determined that a massive glacial collapse, rather than an earthquake, was the primary cause of the deadly flash floods along the Nepal-Tibet border. The falling ice and rock debris triggered a powerful surge in local rivers, resulting in significant loss of life and property. Experts suggest that this disaster highlights the growing risks associated with rapidly melting ice in the Himalayan region.

title: What we know about deadly Nepal-Tibet floods
english: Massive floods and landslides along the Nepal-Tibet border have resulted in significant casualties and left many people missing, prompting urgent rescue operations. While initially thought to be caused by an earthquake, experts now confirm the disaster was triggered by a catastrophic glacial collapse that sent dangerous debris downstream. Scientists suggest that climate change is destabilizing the region by melting glaciers and thawing permafrost, which increases the likelihood of such deadly events.

title: Norway's royal family gathers at King Harald's bedside as his condition worsens
english: King Harald V of Norway is currently in critical condition at an Oslo hospital while receiving treatment for a rare blood disorder. His family, including Queen Sonja and Crown Prince Haakon, have paused their official duties to remain by his side. As the 89-year-old monarch faces this serious health challenge, the Prime Minister and the Norwegian public have expressed their solidarity and concern.
amharic: የኖርዌዩ ንጉሥ ሃራልድ አምስተኛ በደም ሕመም ምክንያት በኦስሎ ሆስፒታል በአስጊ ሁኔታ ላይ እንደሚገኙ ተገልጿል። ንግሥት ሶንያን ጨምሮ የንጉሣዊው ቤተሰብ አባላት ከንጉሡ ጎን ለመሆን የመንግሥት ሥራቸውን አቋርጠዋል። የ89 ዓመቱ ንጉሥ የጤና ሁኔታ አሳሳቢ በመሆኑ የሀገሪቱ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር እና ሕዝቡ ለንጉሣዊ ቤተሰቡ ያላቸውን አጋርነት እየገለጹ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootichi biyya Norwe Ayii Harald V dhibee dhiigaa cimaan hubamanii hospitaala magaalaa Oslo keessatti yaalamaa jiru. title: Man who attacked nun on CCTV in Jerusalem acquitted on grounds of mental health
english: An Israeli court has acquitted Yona Schreiber, a man who was filmed attacking a nun in Jerusalem’s Old City, citing his poor mental health at the time of the incident. Medical professionals determined that he was experiencing a psychotic episode during the assault, leading the judge to order him to a psychiatric facility for up to six years instead of a prison sentence. The attack, which caused significant public outrage, occurred amidst growing concerns over the harassment of Christian clergy and religious figures in the region.

title: Yaya Toure becomes first African coach to lead a team into Champions League
english: Former Ivorian football star Yaya Toure has made history as the first African coach to guide a team into the UEFA Champions League group stage. Since taking over as head coach of the Slovakian club Slovan Bratislava in June, Toure successfully led them through the qualifying rounds to secure their spot. This achievement marks a significant milestone in his post-playing career after he previously won the tournament as a player with Barcelona.

title: Al Jazeera reports from hospital in flood-hit Nepal
english: Severe flash floods have struck several districts across Nepal, causing significant casualties and destruction. Injured victims are currently being transported by air to hospitals in Kathmandu for emergency treatment. Meanwhile, many residents are gathering at these medical facilities to search for information about family members who are still missing.

title: Satellite images show destruction from Nepal-Tibet floods
english: A massive glacier collapse in the Himalayas has caused devastating floods along the border of Nepal and Tibet, resulting in over 270 deaths and leaving 1,300 people missing. The surge of ice, rock, and mud destroyed critical infrastructure, including numerous bridges and roads, which is significantly complicating ongoing rescue efforts. Satellite images confirm extensive damage to settlements and villages, while authorities warn that the casualty count may continue to increase.

title: Trial for 9/11 accused, including Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, set for June 2028
english: A U.S. military judge has scheduled the trial for Khalid Sheikh Mohammed and three co-defendants for June 2028, over two decades after their initial arrest. The legal proceedings were delayed by complex disputes regarding evidence gathered through torture and the recent rejection of prior plea agreements. The trial will now proceed toward a potential death penalty outcome following the cancellation of deals that would have spared the defendants from such sentences.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ዳኛ በሴፕቴምበር 11 ጥቃት ዋና አቀናባሪ ተብለው በሚጠረጠሩት ካሊድ ሼክ መሐመድ እና በሶስት ተባባሪዎቻቸው ላይ የሚካሄደው የፍርድ ሂደት ሰኔ 2028 እንደሚጀመር ወስነዋል። ከሁለት አስርት ዓመታት በላይ የዘለቀው ይህ ጉዳይ በማሰቃየት የተገኙ ማስረጃዎች ላይ በነበሩ አለመግባባቶች እና ቀደም ሲል የተደረጉ የቅጣት ስምምነቶች በከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት በመሰረዛቸው ምክንያት ዘግይቷል። አሁን ጉዳዩ ወደ ሙሉ የፍርድ ሂደት የሚያመራ ሲሆን ተከሳሾቹ የሞት ቅጣት ሊጠብቃቸው የሚችልበት ዕድል አለ።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa waraana Ameerikaa, shakkatamaa haleellaa Septeembarra 11 kan ta'an Khaalid Sheek Mahaammadiifi shakkamtoota biroo saditti fuuleffatee, dhaddachi isaanii Waxabajjii 2028 akka jalqabu murteesseera. Dhaddachi kun waggoota digdama oliif kan ture yoo ta'u, ragaalee qaama irratti miidhaa geessisuun argaman fi waliigaltee duraanii mootummaan haqamuun isaa tursiiseera. Amma garuu dhaddachi kun karaa itti fufuu fi duuti itti murtaa'uu danda'u irra ga'eera.

title: Is Iran war diplomacy ramping up, as Qatar, Oman, Pakistan officials visit?
english: High-level officials from Qatar, Oman, and Pakistan are visiting Tehran to encourage a de-escalation of hostilities between Iran and the United States. These diplomatic efforts are primarily focused on reopening the critical Strait of Hormuz to restore global energy supplies. While both nations remain firm in their positions, these meetings suggest a potential shift toward renewing negotiations.
amharic: የኳታር፣ የኦማን እና የፓኪስታን ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣናት በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት ለማርገብ ወደ ቴህራን በማቅናት ላይ ይገኛሉ። የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቶቹ በዋናነት ለዓለም አቀፍ የኢነርጂ አቅርቦት ወሳኝ የሆነውን የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ መተላለፊያ እንደገና ለመክፈት ያለሙ ናቸው። ሁለቱም ሀገራት በየአቋማቸው ቢጸኑም፣ እነዚህ ጉብኝቶች ወደ ድርድር ለመመለስ ያለውን ፍላጎት የሚያሳዩ ናቸው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoo biyyoota Kaataar, Omaanii fi Paakistaan walitti bu'iinsa Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru tasgabbeessuuf gara Teheran imalaa jiru. Jilli kun kan xiyyeeffatu daandii galaana Hormuz kan daldala anniisaa addunyaaf barbaachisu deebisanii banuudha. Biyyoonni lamaanuu ilaalcha isaanii irratti jabaatanis, mariin kun gara marii nagaatti deebi'uuf abdii akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: Why Turkey is showing restraint over Israeli strikes on Syria
english: Turkey has decided to remain cautious regarding recent Israeli airstrikes in Syria to avoid boosting Benjamin Netanyahu’s political campaign ahead of the upcoming Israeli election. While Ankara views the strikes near its border as a violation of previous security agreements, it prefers to wait for a potential change in Israeli leadership rather than escalating the conflict. Officials in Turkey believe that the current Israeli government is deliberately creating tensions to distract from domestic political pressure.
amharic: ቱርክ በእስራኤል ምርጫ ዋዜማ የቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የፖለቲካ ዘመቻ እንዳይጠናከር በማሰብ፣ በሶሪያ የሚፈጸሙትን የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃቶች በዝምታ ለማለፍ ወስናለች። አንካራ በድንበሯ አቅራቢያ የሚፈጸሙት ጥቃቶች ከዚህ ቀደም ከተደረሱ የጸጥታ ስምምነቶች ውጭ መሆናቸውን ብታምንም፣ ሁኔታውን ወደ ጦርነት ከማምራት ይልቅ የእስራኤል መንግስት ለውጥ እስኪመጣ መጠበቅን መርጣለች። የቱርክ ባለስልጣናት አሁን ያለው የእስራኤል መንግስት የውስጥ የፖለቲካ ጫናውን ለማስቀየር ሲል ሆን ብሎ ውጥረት እንደሚፈጥር ያምናሉ።
oromo: Turkiin filannoo Israa'el dhufuuf jiruun walqabatee, duula filannoo Binyaamin Netaaniyaahuu deeggaruu dhabuuf jecha, haleellaa qilleensa Israa'el biyya Sooriyaa keessatti raawwattu irratti obsaan cal’isuu filatteetti. Ankara haleellaan daangaa ishee biratti raawwatamu kun walii galtee nageenyaa duraan ture kan cabsu ta'uu kan amantu ta'us, waldhabdee kana gara waraanaatti guddisuu mannaa, mootummaan Israa'el jijjiiramu eeguu filatteetti. Hojjettoonni mootummaa Turkii, mootummaan Israa'el amma jiru kun dhiibbaa siyaasaa keessaa jiru irraa xiyyeeffannoo jijjiiruuf jecha oggumaa waldhabdee uumaa jira jedhanii amanu.

title: Pakistan rejects US sanctions on Iran
english: Pakistan has officially refused to follow new US sanctions against Iran, claiming these measures lack a legal foundation under international law. A government spokesperson emphasized that conflicts between nations should be handled through diplomatic communication rather than economic pressure. This decision comes as the US administration increases its financial restrictions against Tehran to force policy changes.
amharic: ፓኪስታን በአሜሪካ የተጣሉባትን አዳዲስ የኢራን ማዕቀቦች እንደማትቀበል በይፋ አስታውቃለች። የአገሪቱ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ቃል አቀባይ እንዳሉት፣ እነዚህ የአንድ ወገን እርምጃዎች ዓለም አቀፍ ህጋዊ መሰረት የሌላቸው በመሆናቸው ሊተገበሩ አይገባም። ይልቁንም አገራት ግጭቶቻቸውን በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውይይት መፍታት እንዳለባቸው አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Paakistaan sagantaa san'ii (gorsaa) Ameerikaan Iraan irratti kaste hordofuu akka hin barbaanne ibsiteetti. Dubbi himaan ministeera dhimma alaa Paakistaan akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun seera idil-addunyaa irratti kan hin hundoofneefi fudhatama kan hin qabne dha. Mootummaan Paakistaan rakkoolee biyyoota gidduu jiran mariidhaan furuun barbaachisaa ta'uusaa ibsiteetti.

title: Iran will defeat enemy in ‘full-scale economic war’, Ghalibaf says
english: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf has characterized the current economic challenges facing the nation as an all-out economic war. Despite these significant pressures, he expressed confidence that Iran would ultimately overcome its adversaries in this ongoing conflict. This statement highlights the Iranian leadership's defiant stance against international economic pressure.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ አፈ-ጉባኤ መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ ሀገሪቱ በአሁኑ ወቅት እያጋጠማት ያለውን የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ እንደ ሙሉ የኢኮኖሚ ጦርነት ገልጸውታል። ምንም እንኳን ከፍተኛ ጫናዎች ቢኖሩም፣ ኢራን በዚህ ጦርነት ተቃዋሚዎቿን እንደምትረታ አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ንግግር የኢራን አመራር በኢኮኖሚ ግፊቶች ላይ ያለውን ጠንካራ አቋም የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyattii Mohaammad Baagir Ghaalibaaf rakkoo diinagdee biyyattii mudate 'waraana diinagdee guutuu' jechuun ibsaniiru. Dhiibbaa cimaa jiru kana keessattuu, Iraan diinota ishee mo'achuuf akka dandeessu amanannaa qaban ibsaniiru. Yaanni kunis mootummaan Iraan dhiibbaa diinagdee irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Israel replaces Damascus Gate name on East Jerusalem signs
english: Israeli authorities in East Jerusalem have replaced the traditional name of Damascus Gate with 'Ancient Gate' on official public signage. Critics and local officials view this change as part of a broader strategy to remove Palestinian cultural symbols and alter the historical identity of the city. While authorities characterize these as administrative updates, many see the renaming as a deliberate effort to erase the area's Arabic and Islamic heritage.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም የሚገኘውን ታዋቂ የደማስቆ በር ስም በይፋዊ ምልክቶች ላይ ወደ 'ጥንታዊ በር' ቀይረዋል። ተቺዎች እና የከተማዋ አስተዳዳሪዎች ይህ ድር Eግት የከተማዋን የፍልስጤም ማንነት ለመሰረዝ እና ታሪካዊ ይዘቱን ለመቀየር የሚደረግ ጥረት እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ። ይህ ለውጥ የአካባቢውን አረብኛ እና እስላማዊ ቅርሶች ከታሪክ ለማጥፋት ያለመ ፖለቲካዊ እርምጃ እንደሆነ እየተነገረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el baha magaalaa Yerusaalemitti mallattoowwan 'Karra Daamaasqoo' jedhamanii beekaman gara 'Karra Durii' jedhutti jijjiireera. Qeeqa kanneen dhiyeessan akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun eenyummaa warra Palastiinii laaffisuufi seenaa magaalaattis jijjiirraa gochuuf kan karoorfame dha. Jijjirri kun dhaalota gara fuulduraa seenaa fi aadaa naannichaa irraa gargar baasuuf kan yaadame ta'uu fi qabeenya aadaa fi seenaa naannichaa haquuf kan taasifame akka ta'e dubbatamaa jira.

title: Haaretz: Israel arms drug dealers to commit ‘war crimes’ and loot homes in Gaza
english: A report from the Israeli newspaper Haaretz alleges that the Israeli military is arming criminal gangs and militias to carry out war crimes and looting within Gaza. These groups are reportedly trained and supported by Israeli security forces to displace residents and operate from fortified bases built on destroyed Palestinian property. This ongoing collaboration has sparked significant controversy, as these militias are widely viewed by Palestinians as traitors for their role in the region's destruction.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጋዜጣ ሃአሬትዝ እንደዘገበው የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በጋዛ ጦር ወንጀሎችን እና ዘረፋዎችን እንዲፈጽሙ የወንጀለኛ ቡድኖችን እና ታጣቂዎችን እያስታጠቀ ይገኛል። እነዚህ ቡድኖች በእስራኤል የደህንነት ኃይሎች እየሰለጠኑ እና እየታገዙ ፍልስጤማውያንን ከቤታቸው በማፈናቀል በአስፈላጊ ቦታዎች ላይ ሲንቀሳቀሱ ቆይተዋል። ይህ ትብብር በጋዛ ለሚገኙ ፍልስጤማውያን ከፍተኛ ቁጣን ቀስቅሷል፤ ብዙዎቹም እነዚህን ቡድኖች እንደ ከዳተኛ በመቁጠር ይቃወሟቸዋል።
oromo: Gaazexaan Israa'el Haaretz akka gabaaseetti, waraanni Israa'el yakka waraanaa fi saamicha Gaza keessatti raawwachuuf gareewwan yakka raawwatan fi hidhattoota leenjisaa fi meeshaan gargaaraa jiraachuu ibseera. Gareewwan kunneen buufatawwan Israa'el ijaarte keessa taa'uun lammiilee Falasxiin mana isaanii irraa ari'uuf kan fayyadaman yoo ta'u, kunis tarkaanfii seeraan alaa ta'uu gabaasichi ni ibsa. Hojiiwwan gareewwan kunneenii Falasxiinota biratti akka gantummaatti kan ilaalamu yoo ta'u, kunis rakkoo fi miidhaa naannichatti ga'aa jiru daran kan hammaachiseedha.

title: Ethiopia’s Future Demands Axum–Harar Synergy
english: Ethiopian civilization is defined by the interaction between two major historical centers: the northern Christian tradition of Axum and the eastern Islamic tradition of Harar. While many diverse ethnic groups have contributed to the nation’s growth, these two regions represent long-standing institutional foundations that linked the country to global trade and scholarship. Acknowledging both legacies provides a more complete understanding of Ethiopia's complex past and identity.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ስልጣኔ በሰሜኑ የአክሱም ክርስትና እና በምስራቁ የሐረር እስልምና ወግ መካከል በተደረገ ግንኙነት የተገነባ ነው። ምንም እንኳን ሌሎች ብሄር ብሄረሰቦች ለሀገሪቱ እድገት ትልቅ አስተዋጽኦ ቢኖራቸውም፣ እነዚህ ሁለት ማዕከላት ለረጅም ዘመን የዘለቁ የሀገሪቱ መሰረቶች ናቸው። ሁለቱንም ታሪካዊ ቅርሶች ማመጣጠን የኢትዮጵያን የቆየ እና ውስብስብ ታሪክ በተሟላ ሁኔታ ለመረዳት ይረዳል።
oromo: Siivilizeeshiniin Itoophiyaa bu'uura lama irratti kan ijaarame yoo ta'u, isaanis aadaa kiristaanummaa kan kaabaa (Aksum) fi aadaa islaamummaa kan bahaa (Harar) dha. Saboonni fi sab-lammoonni biyyattii hedduun gumaacha ol'aanaa taasisaniiru; haa ta'u malee, Aksum fi Harar bu'uuraalee ciccimoowwan seenaa Itoophiyaa keessatti bakka guddaa qabu. Seenaa akkasii kana lamaanuu walitti fiduun Itoophiyaa beekuuf gargaara.

title: US drug agency approves breakthrough treatment for pancreatic cancer
english: The US Food and Drug Administration has approved a new daily pill, daraxonrasib, to treat pancreatic cancer. Clinical trials showed that the medication significantly extends patient survival time by blocking a specific gene mutation that drives tumor growth. This approval offers a vital new alternative for patients battling this highly aggressive and difficult-to-treat form of cancer.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የምግብ እና የመድኃኒት አስተዳደር የጣፊያ ካንሰርን ለማከም የሚያገለግል ዳራክሶንራሲብ የተሰኘ አዲስ በየቀኑ የሚወሰድ መድሃኒትን አጽድቋል። ክሊኒካዊ ሙከራዎች እንደሚያሳዩት መድሃኒቱ የካንሰር እድገትን የሚያነሳሳውን ጂን በመግታት የታካሚዎችን የህይወት ዘመን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ማራዘም ችሏል። ይህ ማጽደቅ እጅግ አስቸጋሪ ለሆነው የዚህ አይነት ካንሰር ተጋላጭ ለሆኑ ታካሚዎች ትልቅ ተስፋን የሚሰጥ አዲስ አማራጭ ነው።
oromo: Bulchiinsi Nyaataa fi Qoricha US qoricha guyyaa guyyaan fudhatamu kan 'daraxonrasib' jedhamu dhukkuba kaansarii ujummoo garaa (pancreatic cancer) wal'aanuuf hayyameera. Qorannoon kilinikaa akka agarsiisutti, qorichi kun guddina kaansarii kanaa kan fidu 'gene' jijjiirama fide to'achuudhaan umurii warra dhukkubsatanii dheeressuu danda'eera. Hayyamni kun dhukkuba cimaa fi wal'aanuun ulfaataa ta'e kanaan miidhamaniif filannoo haaraa fi abdii guddaa kenna.

title: At least 12 dead, 54 injured as wildfires ravage northeastern Algeria
english: Severe wildfires fueled by a heatwave have killed at least 12 people and injured 54 others across northeastern Algeria. Firefighting teams are currently working to control over 150 active blazes, with officials evacuating numerous families from the most dangerous areas. These deadly fires are becoming more frequent in the region due to rising temperatures and ongoing drought conditions.
amharic: በአልጄሪያ ሰሜናዊ ምስራቅ ክፍል በተከሰተ ከፍተኛ የሙቀት መጠን የታጀበ የሰደድ እሳት ቢያንስ 12 ሰዎችን ሲገድል 54 ሰዎችን አቁስሏል። የእሳት አደጋ መከላከያ ሰራተኞች ከ150 በላይ የሚሆኑ የእሳት ቃጠሎዎችን ለመቆጣጠር እየታገሉ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናትም አደጋው ከተጋረጠባቸው አካባቢዎች ብዙ ቤተሰቦችን ለቀው እንዲወጡ አድርገዋል። እነዚህ አደገኛ የእሳት ቃጠሎዎች በድርቅ እና በከፍተኛ የሙቀት መጨመር ምክንያት በአካባቢው ተደጋጋሚ እየሆኑ መጥተዋል።
oromo: Aljeeriya kibba-bahaa keessatti qilleensa goginsa qabuun walqabatee ibidda bosonaa ka'een namoonni 12 du'anii 54 madaa'aniiru. Gareen dhaabicha ibiddaa ibidda 150 ol ta'an to'achuuf halkanii guyyaa hojjechaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, mootummaan namoota naannoo balaa kanaa jiran baasuu jalqabeera. Balaan ibiddaa kun jijjiirama qilleensaafi hongeen kan walqabatu ta'uun isaa hubatameera.

title: Pro-Israel Democrats picked for top roles on key US House committee
english: The US House of Representatives has appointed three pro-Israel Democrats to significant roles within the Foreign Affairs Committee. These selections follow primary election victories by these lawmakers over progressive challengers who opposed their stance on Israel. The move has sparked criticism from within the party, as many members believe these appointments do not reflect the shifting public opinion and growing disapproval of US aid to Israel among voters.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት ሶስት እስራኤልን የሚደግፉ ዲሞክራቶችን በውጭ ጉዳይ ኮሚቴ ውስጥ በዋናነት መርጧል። እነዚህ ሹመቶች የተሰጡት የፓርቲው አባላት እስራኤልን ለሚቃወሙ ተፎካካሪዎች በአንደኛ ደረጃ ምርጫ ድል ከተቀዳጁ በኋላ ነው። ሆኖም ይህ ውሳኔ በፓርቲው ውስጥ ቅሬታ የፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ አስተያየቱ በአሜሪካ ህዝብ ዘንድ እስራኤልን የሚደግፉ ፖሊሲዎች እየቀነሱ መምጣታቸውን ከግምት ውስጥ ያላስገባ ነው የሚል ትችት እየቀረበበት ነው።
oromo: Mana maree bakka buutota ummataa Ameerikaa keessatti, miseensonni paartii Diimookiraata kan Israa'eliif deggarsa qaban sadan tokko komitii dhimma alaa keessatti aangoo olaanaa qabataniiru. Muudamni kun kan raawwatame yeroo miseensonni kun mormitoota Israa'eliin mormanii turan injifatanitti. Haata'u malee, murteen kun miseensota paartichaa tokko tokko biratti mormii kan kaase yoo ta'u, yaanni kun yaada ummata Ameerikaa kan Israa'eliif deggarsa kennuun hir'achaa jiru waliin kan wal-hin-simne ta'uu ibsameera.

title: Is Mark Ruffalo anti-Semitic?
english: Actor Mark Ruffalo is facing accusations of anti-Semitism after criticizing the family involved in a major media deal. He targeted them for providing technology that Israel allegedly uses in its actions against Palestinians. Critics are debating whether these accusations are a genuine response to his comments or a distraction from broader discussions about media ownership in the United States.
amharic: ተዋናይ ማርክ ሩፋሎ በአንድ ትልቅ የሚዲያ ስምምነት ውስጥ ከተሳተፈ ቤተሰብ ጋር በተያያዘ ባነሷቸው ትችቶች የፀረ-ሴማዊነት ክስ ቀርቦባቸዋል። እርሳቸው ይህን ቤተሰብ የገለጹት እስራኤል በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ የምትጠቀምበትን ቴክኖሎጂ በማቅረብ ነው በማለት ነው። ነገር ግን፣ እነዚህ ክሶች ለትችቱ የተሰጡ ትክክለኛ ምላሾች ናቸው ወይስ በአሜሪካ የሚዲያ ባለቤትነት ላይ የሚደረገውን ክርክር ለማዘናጋት የተፈጠሩ ናቸው የሚለው ጉዳይ ክርክር አስነስቷል።
oromo: Aartist Mark Ruffalo maatii waliigaltee midiyaa gurguddaa keessatti hirmaatan tokkorratti komii kaasuun isaa, himata jibba Yihuudii (anti-Semitism) irratti akka ka'u godheera. Inni maatii kana kan komate, teeknoolojii Israa'el loltoota ishee keessatti itti fayyadamtu dhiheessuudhaan himatamuun isaaniiti. Ta'us, himatni kun qeeqawwan inni kaaseef deebii dhugaa dha moo, dhimma abbummaa miidiyaa Ameerikaa ilaalchisee yaada uummataa jallisuuf kan qophaaye dha kan jedhu irratti falmiin jira.

title: Construction worker documents moment he survives Nepal mudslide
english: A construction worker in Nepal’s Rasuwa district captured intense footage of a mudslide forcing his team to flee for their lives. The disaster destroyed critical infrastructure like roads and bridges in the Mailung area. Eventually, emergency responders used a helicopter to rescue the worker and over 100 other stranded individuals.
amharic: በኔፓል ራስዋ አውራጃ ውስጥ የሚሠራ አንድ የግንባታ ሠራተኛ በድንገተኛ የመሬት መንሸራተት ወቅት ሕይወቱን ለማትረፍ ሲሯሯጥ የሚያሳይ ቪዲዮ ቀርጿል። ጎርፉ በሜይሉንግ አካባቢ የሚገኙ መንገዶችንና ድልድዮችን በማውደሙ ሠራተኞቹ ተፈናቅለዋል። በመጨረሻም የነፍስ አድን ሠራተኞች ሄሊኮፕተር በመጠቀም ሠራተኛውን ጨምሮ ከ100 በላይ ሰዎችን በደህና ማውጣት ችለዋል።
oromo: Hojjetaan ijaarsa tokko naannoo Raasuwaa kan Neppaal keessatti, yeroo lolaan dhoqqee fi bishaanii inni fi hoggantoonni isaa lubbuu isaanii oolchuuf itti baqatan viidiyoodhaan qabateera. Balaan kun daandii fi alangeewwan gara naannoo Mailung geessan waan diigeef, hojjettoonni iddoo sanaatti cufamani turan. Dhumarrattis, gargaartonni hatattamaa helikoopteraa fayyadamuun hojjetaa sanaa fi namoota 100 ol ta'an lubbuun oolchaniiru.

title: Syria’s president makes first Visa payment after sanctions removal
english: Syrian President Bashar al-Assad recently used a Visa card for the first time following the removal of his country from the US list of state sponsors of terrorism. This development comes after more than 15 years of strict financial sanctions that had effectively cut Syria off from the international banking network. This move marks a significant shift in Syria's ability to participate in the global financial system.

Tarkaanfiin kun erga waggaa 15 ol darbanii booda dhorkaan baankii idil-addunyaa Siiriyaa irra ture ka'uusaatiin kan danda'ame dha. Kunis biyyattiin sirna faayinaansii addunyaatti deebitee makachuuf carraa akka argattu taasiseera.

title: Video: Survivors recount moment flash floods hit Nepal
english: Survivors of devastating flash floods in Nepal are sharing harrowing stories of how mudslides destroyed their homes and claimed the lives of their loved ones. Rescue operations are currently underway as authorities work to locate the hundreds of people who are still missing. Emergency teams continue to search the affected areas to recover victims and assist those impacted by the tragedy.
amharic: በኔፓል የደረሰው ድንገተኛ ጎርፍ የተረፉ ሰዎች ቤታቸው በጭቃ በመወሰዱ እና ቤተሰቦቻቸው በመጥፋታቸው የደረሰባቸውን ከፍተኛ ሀዘን እየገለጹ ይገኛል። አሁንም በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች የት እንዳሉ ስለማይታወቅ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች በስፋት እየተካሄዱ ነው። የድንገተኛ አደጋ ሰራተኞች የሟቾችን አስክሬን ለመፈለግ እና የተጎዱ ሰዎችን ለመታደግ ጥረታቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Namoonni lolaa tasaa biyya Neeppaal keessatti mudate irraa lubbuun hafan, manneen isaanii fi firoonni isaanii mudii (ciraacha) biyyoon fudhatamuu isaanii gadda guddaadhaan ibsataa jiru. Namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman amma iyyuu bakka bu'an waan hin beekneef, hojiin barbaacha fi lubbuu baraaruu cimsee itti fufeera. Gareewwan gargaarsa ariifachiisaa immoo qaamolee miidhaman gargaaruuf fi reeffa namoota du'anii barbaaduuf tattaaffii godhaa jiru.

title: UNRWA chief: Israel seeks to eliminate agency and Palestinian refugee issue
english: The head of UNRWA, Christian Saunders, has accused Israel of attempting to dismantle the agency by seizing its training facility in East Jerusalem. He stated that these actions are part of a broader goal to invalidate the status of Palestinian refugees. Despite this pressure, the organization maintains that it has no intention of ceasing its operations.
amharic: የUNRWA ኃላፊ ክርስቲያን ሳንደርስ እስራኤል በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም የሚገኘውን የስልጠና ማዕከላቸውን በመውረስ ኤጀንሲውን ለማፍረስ እየሞከረች እንደሆነ ከሰዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የፍልስጤም ስደተኞችን መብት ለመሻር የሚደረግ ጥረት አካል መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በጫናው መሃልም ድርጅቱ ሥራውን ለማቆም ምንም ዕቅድ እንደሌለው አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata UNRWA Kiristiyaan Saandar, Israa'el ganda Quds Bahaa keessatti bakka leenjii isaanii humnaan fudhachuun dhaabbaticha diiguuf yaalaa jirti jechuun himatan. Tarkaanfiin kun haala baqattoota Falasxiin mudaachuuf kan yaadame akka ta'e ibsan. Kunuunni jiruus, dhaabbatichi hojii isaa dhaabuuf karoora akka hin qabne beeksisaniiru.

title: Palestinians demand return of 1,700 bodies held by Israel
english: Palestinians across the occupied West Bank held demonstrations to urge Israeli authorities to return the remains of over 1,700 individuals. Families are also seeking information regarding loved ones who have gone missing. Organizers of the campaign highlight that this issue remains a major point of contention and emotional distress for the Palestinian community.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን እስራኤል የያዘቻቸውን ከ1,700 በላይ የሚሆኑ የሟቾች አስከሬን እንዲመለስ በመጠየቅ ላይ ይገኛሉ። በተጨማሪም ቤተሰቦች የጠፉባቸውን ወገኖቻቸው ሁኔታ ለማወቅ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ይህ ዘመቻ ፍልስጤማውያን ለሟቾቻቸው ያላቸውን ክብር እና የጠፉትን ሰዎች ጉዳይ ለመፍታት የሚያደርጉት ጥረት አካል ነው።
oromo: Palestinoonni naannoo West Bank jiraatan, mootummaan Israa'el reeffa namoota 1,700 ol ta'anii fi qabattee jirtu akka deebistu gaafachuun hiriira bahaniiru. Maatiin namoota kanaa dhibamtoota isaanii kanneen iddoo hin beekamnetti badaniif odeeffannoo barbaadaa jiru. Gurmuun kun rakkoo kana furuuf fi reeffa firoota isaanii sirnaan awwaachuuf mootummaa Israa'el irratti dhiibbaa gochaa jira.

title: US says Chinese-linked hackers attacked NASA, Senate, and gov’t agencies
english: The U.S. government has dismantled a China-linked cyber espionage operation that targeted sensitive agencies like NASA, the Federal Reserve, and the Senate since 2018. Authorities seized two digital platforms used by a Chinese technology firm to mask the origin of their cyberattacks by routing them through compromised devices worldwide. While this action disrupts the hackers' infrastructure, officials acknowledge that it does not completely eliminate the threat group's capabilities.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከቻይና ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው የተባሉ ጠላፊዎች በናሳ፣ በፌደራል ሪዘርቭ እና በሴኔት ላይ ያደረሱትን የሳይበር ጥቃት ማክሸፉን አስታውቋል። እነዚህ ጠላፊዎች ከ2018 ጀምሮ ጥቃታቸውን ለመደበቅ በመላው ዓለም የሚገኙ መሳሪያዎችን በመጠቀም የሳይበር መረቦችን ሲያስተጓጉሉ ነበር። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት የጠላፊዎቹን መረብ ቢቆጣጠሩም፣ የቡድኑ አጠቃላይ የሳይበር ስጋት ሙሉ በሙሉ እንደማያበቃ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa garee haakersoota Chaayinaan deggeraman kan NASA, Federaal Rizervii fi Seeneetii irratti erga bara 2018 as xiyyeeffatanii turan hojiin ala godheera. Gareen kun qindeeffannoo teeknooloojii Chaayinaa fayyadamanii, ergaa isaanii meeshaalee addunyaa maratti argaman keessa erguudhaan eenyummaa isaanii dhoksuuf yaalanii turan. Mootummaan Ameerikaa buufataalee haakersootaa kana to'annoo jala oolchuyyuu, hatattamaan xumura guutuu akka hin taane ibseera.

title: Nigeria launches hunt for hundreds of kidnapped mosque worshippers
english: Nigerian security forces have started a major rescue operation to locate roughly 600 worshippers who were abducted from a mosque in Niger State last week. President Bola Tinubu ordered the mission after a video emerged showing the captives held in a forest, following a violent attack that also resulted in 30 deaths. This mass kidnapping has heightened security concerns in the region ahead of the upcoming presidential election in January.
amharic: የናይጄሪያ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ባለፈው ሳምንት በኒጀር ግዛት ከሚገኝ መስጊድ የታገቱ ወደ 600 የሚጠጉ ምዕመናንን ለማዳን ሰፊ ዘመቻ ጀምረዋል። ፕሬዝዳንት ቦላ ቲኑቡ ታጋቾቹ በጫካ ውስጥ ታስረው የሚያሳይ ምስል ከተለቀቀ በኋላ እና ጥቃቱ 30 ሰዎችን ከገደለ በኋላ የነፍስ አድን ስራውን አዝዘዋል። ይህ የጅምላ ጠለፋ በጥር ወር በሚካሄደው ምርጫ ዋዜማ በሀገሪቱ የጸጥታ ስጋትን እጅግ አባብሶታል።
oromo: Humnoonni nageenyaa Naayijeeriyaa torban darbe giddu-galeessa biyyattii godina Niijeritti masjidarraa namoota 600 ta'an gidirfaman bilisa baasuuf duula bal'aa jalqabaniiru. Pirezidaanti Bolaa Tiinubuu erga viidiyoon namoonni kunneen bosona keessatti hidhamanii argamaniin booda akkasumas namoonni 30 haleellaa sanaan ajjeefamanii booda ajaja kana kennaniiru. Namoota baay'ee butuun kun ji'a Amajjii dhufu filannoon pirezidaantummaa geggeeffamuun dura yaaddoo nageenyaa biyyattii daran dabaleera.

title: Lawmakers call on Rubio to intervene in case of US citizen detained by Israel
english: Over 40 Democratic members of Congress have requested that Secretary of State Marco Rubio assist in the release of Sama Safi, a 20-year-old American citizen detained by Israel since June without formal charges. The lawmakers emphasize that Safi suffers from a serious chronic illness that is worsening significantly due to poor conditions in prison. They are calling for intervention because medical professionals warn that her continued incarceration could lead to permanent, life-threatening organ damage.
amharic: ከ40 በላይ የዴሞክራቲክ የኮንግረስ አባላት የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ በእስራኤል ያለ ክስ ከሰኔ ወር ጀምሮ ታስራ የምትገኘውን ሳማ ሳፊ የተባለች የአሜሪካ ዜጋ ጉዳይ እንዲመለከቱ ጠይቀዋል። ህግ አውጪዎቹ ሳፊ አደገኛ የሆነ ሥር የሰደደ የጤና እክል እንዳለባት እና እስር ቤቱ ባለው መጥፎ ሁኔታ ሳቢያ ጤንነቷ እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ገልጸዋል። የህክምና ባለሙያዎች እስሯ ከቀጠለ ለሕይወቷ አደገኛ የሆነ ጉዳት ሊያጋጥማት እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Miseensoni Kongiresii Demokiraatawaa 40 ol ta'an, Ministeera Dhimma Alaa Maarko Ruubiyootti fayyadamuun, lammii Ameerikaa kan taate Samaa Saafii, ji'a Waxabajjii irraa eegalee himannaa tokko malee mana hidhaa Israa'el keessatti argamtu akka gadi dhiifamtu gaafataniiru. Miseensoni kun akka jedhanitti, Samaa dhukkuba cimaa fi suuta namatti babal'atu qabdi, akkasumas haalli mana hidhaa sun fayyaa ishee caalaatti miidhaa jira. Ogeeyyonni fayyaa akka hubachiisanitti, yoo hidhaan kun itti fufe, qaamni ishee miidhaa fayyaa suphamu hin dandeenye fi lubbuu ishee darbuu danda'uuf saaxilamuu danda'a.

title: Israeli forces detain two brothers during Nablus raid
english: Israeli military forces arrested two brothers, Bilal and Hamza Bassam Ziada, during an operation in the village of Madama, located near Nablus in the West Bank. The arrests occurred after soldiers conducted a series of raids and questioned several residents in the area. Local news outlets reported that these detentions were part of broader security activities carried out by Israeli troops.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በዌስት ባንክ ናብሉስ አቅራቢያ በምትገኘው ማዳማ መንደር ባደረጉት ዘመቻ ቢላል ባሳም ዚያዳ እና ሀምዛ ባሳም ዚያዳ የተባሉ ሁለት ወንድማማቾችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። እስሩ የተፈጸመው ወታደሮቹ በመንደሩ ውስጥ ተከታታይ ፍተሻዎችን እና ምርመራዎችን ካደረጉ በኋላ ነው። የሀገር ውስጥ የዜና ምንጮች እንደዘገቡት ከሆነ እነዚህ ወንድማማቾች የታሰሩት በእስራኤል ጦር በተካሄደው ሰፊ የፀጥታ ዘመቻ ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el ganda Maadaamaa kan Naablus, Qaxxaamura Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti argamtu keessatti obboloota lama, Bilaal Basaam Ziyaadaa fi Hamzaa Basaam Ziyaadaa to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Hidhiin kun kan hordofe, loltoonni ganda sana keessatti duula sakatta'iinsaa fi gaaffii gaafachuu erga gaggeessanii booda dha. Maddoonni oduu akka gabaasanitti, qabamuun obboloota kanaa hojiiwwan nageenyaa humnoonni Israa'el naannichatti gaggeessaa jiran keessaa tokko.

title: Lawmakers call on Rubio to intervene in case of US citizen detained by Israel
english: Over 40 US lawmakers are pressuring Secretary of State Marco Rubio to secure the release of Sama Safi, a 20-year-old American citizen detained by Israel since June without charge. Safi suffers from a serious chronic illness that is worsening due to poor prison conditions and a lack of necessary medical care. While Israel claims she is involved in militant activities, her legal counsel and family maintain she is innocent and was arrested simply for her university student activities.
amharic: ከ40 በላይ የዩኤስ ህግ አውጪዎች የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሩ ማርኮ ሩቢዮ ከሰኔ ወር ጀምሮ በእስራኤል እስር ቤት ያለምንም ክስ የታሰረችውን የአሜሪካ ዜጋ ሳማ ሳፊን እንዲያስፈቱ ግፊት እያደረጉ ነው። የ20 ዓመቷ ተማሪ ሳማ ሳፊ በከባድ የጤና እክል የምትሰቃይ ሲሆን፣ በእስር ቤቱ ውስጥ ባለው አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ እና ተገቢውን የህክምና እርዳታ ባለማግኘቷ ህይወቷ ለአደጋ ተጋልጧል። እስራኤል ተማሪዋን ከአሸባሪ ቡድኖች ጋር ግንኙነት አላት ብላ ብትከስም፣ ቤተሰቦቿ እና ጠበቃዋ ግን የታሰረችው በዩኒቨርሲቲ ተሳትፎዋ ምክንያት መሆኑን በመግለጽ ክሱን አስተባብለዋል።
oromo: Miseensonni seera baastuu Ameerikaa 40 ol ta'an, dubartii lammii Ameerikaa Samaa Saafii jedhamtu kan ji'a Waxabajjii irraa jalqabee yakka tokko malee mana hidhaa Israa'el keessa jirtu akka hiisisan Ministira Dhimma Alaa Maarko Ruubiyootti dhiibbaa gochaa jiru. Samaa Saafiin umurii ishee waggaa 20 ta'ee fi dhibee cimaa fayyaa waan qabduuf, haala mana hidhaa fi dhabamuu wal'aansa fayyaatiin jireenyi ishee balaadhaaf saaxilameera. Israa'el garee finxaaleyyiin wal qabatti jechuun yakka irratti banus, maatii fi abukaatoon ishee garuu barattuu yunivarsiitii ta'uu isheetiin malee yakka tokko akka hin qabne ibsu.

title: Israeli forces shoot, injure two Palestinians near Jerusalem
english: Israeli military forces conducted a raid on the town of Beit Anan near Jerusalem this Wednesday, resulting in injuries to two Palestinian men. During the operation, soldiers deployed live ammunition and tear gas, causing a gunshot wound to one of the individuals. Both victims were transported to a medical facility for treatment, where one remains in stable condition.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ረቡዕ ምሽት በኢየሩሳሌም አቅራቢያ በምትገኘው በቤት አናን ከተማ ባደረጉት ወረራ ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል። ወታደሮቹ ጥይት እና አስለቃሽ ጭስ በመጠቀም አንዱን ሰው በጉልበቱ ላይ በጥይት መትተው አቁስለዋል። ሁለቱም ሰዎች ለህክምና ወደ ሆስፒታል የተወሰዱ ሲሆን የአንዱ ሁኔታ የተረጋጋ መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Raayyaa ittisa biyya Israa'el guyyaa Roobii darbe magaala Yerusaalemitti dhihoo jirtu Beet Anaaniin weeraruun namoota Falasxiin lama miidheera. Waraanni Israa'el dhukaasaa fi gaasii imimmaan fiduu fayyadamuun namoota kunneen keessaa tokko jilbaan rukutanii miidhaniiru. Namoonni lameenuu gara hospitaalaatti geeffamuun yaalamaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, tokko isaanii haalli isaa tasgabbaa'aa akka ta'e gabaafameera.

title: Yemen’s Houthis fire ballistic missiles at al-Markha
english: Houthi forces launched a series of ballistic missiles from Taiz toward Yemen's western coast on Wednesday. The attack targeted the port of Mocha and the al-Khawkhah region, resulting in multiple impacts across these areas. Yemeni military officials confirmed the strikes originated from territories currently held by the Houthis.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ረቡዕ ዕለት ከታይዝ አቅጣጫ ወደ የመን ምዕራባዊ የባህር ዳርቻ ተከታታይ የባላስቲክ ሚሳኤሎችን ተኩሰዋል። ጥቃቱ የሞካ ወደብን እና የአል-ካውካህ አካባቢን ያነጣጠረ ሲሆን ሚሳኤሎቹ በተጠቀሱት ቦታዎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። የየመን ወታደራዊ ምንጮች ሚሳኤሎቹ የተተኮሱት በሁቲዎች ቁጥጥር ስር ባሉ አካባቢዎች መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Humni Houthi Dilbata darbe naannoo Taiz irraa gara qarqara galaana lixa Yamanitti xiyyaara balistii hedduu ergeera. Hojiin waraanaa kun buufata Mocha fi naannoo al-Khawkhah irratti kan xiyyeeffate yoo ta'u, miidhaan garagaraas qaqqabeera. Maddoonni waraanaa Yaman akka ibsanitti, xiyyaaronni kun hundi kanneen to'annoo Houthi jala jiran irraa kan dhuman ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Kurdish-led SDF has dissolved, but has Syria really unified its military?
english: The Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) have officially dissolved and merged into the Syrian national army. While this marks a significant achievement for Damascus in consolidating state power, experts warn that the transition remains complex due to ongoing uncertainties regarding military command and control. This shift follows years of conflict and recent geopolitical changes, including the withdrawal of support from the United States.
amharic: በኩርድ የሚመሩት የሶሪያ ዴሞክራቲክ ኃይሎች (SDF) በይፋ ተፈትተው ከሶሪያ ብሔራዊ ጦር ጋር ተቀላቅለዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የሶሪያ መንግሥት አገሪቱን በአንድ ማዕከል ሥር ለማስተዳደር ለሚያደርገው ጥረት ትልቅ ድል ቢሆንም፣ የጦር ኃይሉን አደረጃጀት እና ትዕዛዝ በተመለከተ እስካሁን ያልተፈቱ ውስብስብ ጥያቄዎች እንዳሉ ባለሙያዎች ይገልጻሉ። ይህ ለውጥ የመጣው ከረጅም ዓመታት የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት እና የአሜሪካ ድጋፍ መቋረጥ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni Demokraatawaa Sooriyaa (SDF) kanneen Kooridotaan hogganaman erga diigamanii booda, loltootni isaanii raayyaa ittisa biyyattii waliin makamaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun mootummaan Sooriyaa biyyattii guutummaatti to'annoo isaa jala galchuuf milkaa'ina guddaa ta'us, abbootiin seeraa garuu ajaja waraanaa fi caasaa haaraa kana irratti shakkiin jiraachuu ibsaniiru. Jijjiiramni kun kan dhufe waraana waggoota dheeraa booda fi mootummaan Amerikaa deeggarsa isaa dhaabuun isaa hordofee dha.

title: UEFA set to end boycott of FIFA events over Infantino’s failed selloff
english: UEFA plans to formally drop its threat to boycott FIFA events after receiving guarantees that Gianni Infantino’s controversial proposal to sell a stake in the World Cup will not be revived. This decision ensures that six European nations can participate in the upcoming FIFA Under-20 Women’s World Cup in Poland without disruption. The move effectively resolves the tension caused by the rejected $20 billion investor plan that previously sparked widespread criticism across global football.
amharic: የአውሮፓ እግር ኳስ ማህበር (UEFA) የፊፋን ውድድሮች ላለመቀላቀል የነበረውን ማስፈራሪያ በይፋ ሊያነሳ ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰነው የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ለዓለም ዋንጫ የንግድ መብቶች የነበራቸው አወዛጋቢ የሽያጭ እቅድ እንደማይቀጥል ማረጋገጫ ካገኙ በኋላ ነው። በዚህም ምክንያት ስድስት የአውሮፓ አገራት በፖላንድ በሚካሄደው ከ20 ዓመት በታች የሴቶች ዓለም ዋንጫ ላይ ያለ ምንም እንቅፋት ለመሳተፍ ዝግጅታቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: UEFA fi FIFA gidduutti wal dhabdee uumame ture furameera; kunis UEFA tarkaanfii FIFA irratti fudhachuu qabuuf karoorsu dhiisuuf murteesseera. Murtoon kun kan dhufeyyuu pirezidaantii FIFA Jiyaanii Infantiinoo karoora gatii World Cup gurguruuf qaban irra deebi'amee akka hin kaane waadaa erga galanii booda. Bu'aan isaas, biyyoonni Awurooppaa ja'a ta'an morkiiwwan FIFA irratti hirmaachuu akka itti fufan kan dandeessisuudha.

title: US imposes sanctions on Palestine Action and other left-wing groups
english: The United States government has placed financial sanctions on Palestine Action, the international group Masar Badil, and the Italian tech organization Autistici Inventati. These measures are part of a broader crackdown by the Trump administration against groups that oppose Israeli policies. Activists are criticizing these actions, arguing that they follow the controversial precedent set by the UK government's recent designation of Palestine Action as a terrorist group, which they claim threatens freedom of speech.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በፍልስጤም ደጋፊ ቡድኖች ላይ ማዕቀብ ጥሏል። እነዚህ ማዕቀቦች የተጣሉት በፍልስጤም አክሽን፣ በማሳር ባዲል እና በጣሊያን የቴክኖሎጂ ድርጅት አውቲስቲቺ ኢንቬንታቲ ላይ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ የእስራኤልን ፖሊሲዎች በሚቃወሙ ቡድኖች ላይ የአሜሪካ አስተዳደር እያደረሰ ያለውን ተጽዕኖ ያሳያል። አክቲቪስቶች ይህ ድርጊት የመናገር ነጻነትን የሚጋፋ መሆኑን በመጥቀስ በብሪታንያ የተጀመረውን የጭቆና አካሄድ የሚከተል እንደሆነ ተችተዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa gareewwan deggertoota Falasxiin irratti tajaajila maallaqaa fi uggura biroo kaa’eera. Uggurri kunis garee 'Palestine Action', 'Masar Badil' fi dhaabbata teeknooloojii Xaaliyaanii 'Autistici Inventati' irratti kan xiyyeeffate dha. Tarkaanfiin kun bulchiinsi Traamp siyaasa Israa'el mormuun irratti duula banuu isaa kan agarsiisu dha. Hojjettoonni mirga namoomaa fi aktivistoonni tarkaanfiin kun mirga yaada ibsachuu kan tuquu fi mootummaan Biritish 'Palestine Action' irratti fudhateen kan deeggarame ta'uu isaa dubbataniiru.

title: Trump says Iran war will continue for as long as necessary
english: President Donald Trump has stated that the conflict with Iran will persist as long as he deems it essential. He noted that the newly implemented economic sanctions are providing results comparable to the impact of military airstrikes. Consequently, the administration has not established a specific timeline for when these hostilities will conclude.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር ያለው ግጭት አስፈላጊ ሆኖ እስከተገኘ ድረስ እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቀዋል። አዲሱ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ ከወታደራዊ የአየር ጥቃት ጋር የሚመጣጠን ውጤት እያስገኘ መሆኑንም ገልጸዋል። በዚህም የተነሳ፣ አስተዳደሩ ጦርነቱ መቼ እንደሚጠናቀቅ የሚያሳይ የተለየ የጊዜ ሰሌዳ አልያዘም።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Traamp walitti bu'iinsi Iraan wajjin jiru hamma barbaachisaa ta'etti kan itti fufu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin diinagdee haaraan fudhatame bu'aa lola waraanaa wajjin wal gitu akka fidu dubbataniiru. Kanaafuu, mootummaan isaanii yeroo loluun kun xumuramuufi qabuuf guyyaa murtaa'aa hin qabu.

title: US inflation remains sticky in July
english: US inflation remained at 3.7 percent in July, staying significantly higher than the Federal Reserve's 2 percent goal. This persistent trend is largely driven by rising energy costs linked to the ongoing conflict involving the US, Israel, and Iran. Consequently, there is growing speculation that the central bank may decide to increase interest rates as early as next month to address these economic pressures.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የዋጋ ንረት በሐምሌ ወር በ3.7 በመቶ በመቆየቱ የፌዴራል ሪዘርቭ ከያዘው የ2 በመቶ ግብ በላይ ሆኗል። ይህ ቀጣይነት ያለው የዋጋ ንረት በአብዛኛው በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ባለው ግጭት ምክንያት በተፈጠረው የነዳጅ ዋጋ መናር የተከሰተ ነው። በዚህም የተነሳ፣ የኢኮኖሚ ጫናውን ለመቆጣጠር የሀገሪቱ ማዕከላዊ ባንክ በሚቀጥለው ወር የወለድ ምጣኔን ሊጨምር ይችላል የሚል ግምት ተጠናክሯል።
oromo: Gatiin gabaa Amerikaatti ji'a July keessa garaagarummaa %3.7 irra dhaabbateera; kunis akkaataa karoora Baankii Federaalawaa kan %2 oli. Daballiin gatii kun kan mudate walitti bu'iinsa Amerikaa, Israa'el fi Iraan gidduutti uumameen gatiin boba'aa waan dabaleefidha. Haaluma kanaan, dhiibbaa diinagdee kana to'achuuf jecha, baankiin giddugaleessaa ji'a dhufu keessa dhala baankii dabaluu danda'a jedhamee eegama.

title: Iran says US sanctions will achieve nothing
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has rejected the effectiveness of new United States economic sanctions, claiming they will fail just like previous military efforts. The two nations remain in a tense standoff involving the control of the Strait of Hormuz and ongoing naval blockades. Despite these pressures, Iran maintains its commitment to resisting American economic measures.
amharic: የኢራኑ ፕሬዚዳንት ማሱድ ፔዜሽኪያን አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የጣለችው አዲስ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ ቀደም ሲል ከነበሩት ወታደራዊ ሙከራዎች ሁሉ ውጤት አልባ እንደሚሆን ተናግረዋል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት መቆጣጠር እና በባህር ኃይል እገዳዎች ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ውጥረት ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ምንም እንኳን ግፊቶች ቢኖሩም ኢራን በአሜሪካ የኢኮኖሚ ጫናዎች ላይ ጸንታ እንደምትቆም አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeshkiyaan adabbiin diinagdee Ameerikaan Iraan irratti har'a kaa'e akka hin milkoofneefi qabsoo waraanaa kanaan dura turee wajjin tokko akka ta'e dubbatan. Biyyonni lamaan kun to'annoo iddoo 'Strait of Hormuz' fi duula galaanaa irratti wal dorgomuun waldhabdee keessa jiru. Dhiibbaan diinagdee jiraatus, Iraan dhiibbaa kana hunda dandamattee akka itti fuftu ibsiteetti.

title: US designates Palestine Action activist group 'Specially Designated Global Terrorist'
english: The U.S. government has labeled the UK-based activist group Palestine Action as a global terrorist organization. This move is part of a broader crackdown on groups identified as violent far-left networks. The decision follows a previous ban by the UK government due to the group's history of targeting weapons manufacturers that supply the Israeli military.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግሥት በእንግሊዝ ላይ የተመሰረተውን 'ፓለስታይን አክሽን' የተሰኘውን የቡድን አባላት በአለም አቀፍ የሽብርተኝነት ዝርዝር ውስጥ አስገብቷቸዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የግራ ዘመም ቡድኖችን ለመቆጣጠር ከተወሰዱ እርምጃዎች አንዱ ነው። ቡድኑ ለእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ በሚያደርጉ የጦር መሣሪያ ፋብሪካዎች ላይ ጉዳት በማድረሱ ከዚህ ቀደም በእንግሊዝ መንግሥት መታገዱ ይታወሳል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa garee aktvistoota UK keessatti hundaa'e 'Palestine Action' jedhamu akka dhaabbata shororkeessaa addunyaatti moggaaseera. Tarkaanfiin kun gareewwan harka bitaa jiran jedhaman irratti duula gaggeeffamaa jiru keessatti kan fudhatame dha. Gareen kun qindoomina meeshaa waraanaa kan Israa'el gargaaran irratti miidhaa geessisuun isaa kan duran mootummaan UK irratti dhorkaa kaa'eef ture.

title: US designates Palestine Action activist group 'Specially Designated Global Terrorist'
english: The Trump administration has officially labeled the UK-based activist group Palestine Action as a 'Specially Designated Global Terrorist' organization. US officials accuse the group of causing significant property damage at defense facilities and promoting violent tactics. This action follows the UK's previous decision to ban the group, and the US has also extended sanctions to the revolutionary movement Masar Badil.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የሚንቀሳቀሰውን 'ፓለስታይን አክሽን' የተባለውን ቡድን 'አለም አቀፍ አሸባሪ' ሲል ሰይሞታል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ቡድኑ የመከላከያ ተቋማትን በመጉዳት እና ጥቃትን የሚያበረታቱ ድርጊቶችን በመፈጸም እንደከሰሱት ገልጸዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከዚህ ቀደም እንግሊዝ ቡድኑን ከከለከለች በኋላ የተወሰደ ሲሆን፣ አሜሪካም በ'ማሳር ባዲል' የተባለ ሌላ ንቅናቄ ላይ ተመሳሳይ ማዕቀብ ጥላለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa garee aktvistoota UK kan ta'e 'Palestine Action' jedhamu 'shororkeessaa addunyaa' jechuun moggaaseera. Aangeyyoonni Ameerikaa gareen kun bakkeewwan waraanaa miidhuu fi gochaaleen hamoo akka babal'atan gochuu isaa himataniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyi UK kanaan dura garee kana erga dhorkitee booda kan dhufe yoo ta'u, Ameerikaan sochii 'Masar Badil' jedhamus sanadaa (sanctions) jalatti galchiteetti.

title: Hegseth says military action still possible in US-Israel war on Iran
english: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced that military force remains a potential option in the ongoing conflict against Iran. This statement follows the recent implementation of major economic sanctions by the United States. Hegseth clarified that while economic pressure is currently the primary focus, the U.S. is still prepared to carry out kinetic strikes if necessary to secure the Strait of Hormuz.

Albanese believes this move is a strategy to silence widespread dissent by punishing specific individuals and organizations.

title: Putin and al-Sharaa discuss Russia-Syria relations, deal on military bases
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin and Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa recently held discussions to strengthen diplomatic and economic ties. english: Thieves executed a lightning-fast robbery at a Tokyo shopping center, stealing luxury watches valued at $1.2 million in just ten seconds. title: Video: Man kills eight relatives in Montana gun attack

title: Rescuers search for hundreds missing in Nepal-Tibet flash floods
english: Emergency teams in Nepal are currently conducting large-scale search operations to locate hundreds of individuals reported missing following severe flash floods along the border with Tibet. title: Syria removed: Which countries are still on the US ‘terror’ list – and why?
english: The United States has officially removed Syria from its list of State Sponsors of Terrorism following the collapse of the Bashar al-Assad regime. This change, which ends a designation that had been in place since 1979, follows assurances from the new leadership regarding international security. Currently, only Cuba, Iran, and North Korea remain on this American blacklist.

english: The Trump administration has warned that it may demolish the Kennedy Center if court orders prevent planned renovations and the inclusion of the President's name on the building.
