title: Why a Christian group is suing the Dutch government for West Bank trade ban
english: A Dutch evangelical group called Christians for Israel is suing the government to block a new ban on importing products from illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank and Golan Heights. The group argues that the upcoming September deadline does not provide enough time to sell their current inventory of 20,000 wine bottles and claims the policy violates European free trade rules. While the EU currently only requires such products to be labeled by their specific origin, the Netherlands has decided to implement its own outright import ban for the next three years.
amharic: ክርስቲያኖች ለእስራኤል የተሰኘ የደች ወንጌላዊ ቡድን፣ በዌስት ባንክ እና በጎላን ሃይትስ በሚገኙ ህገ-ወጥ የእስራኤል ሰፈራዎች የሚመረቱ ምርቶችን ወደ ሀገር ውስጥ እንዳይገቡ የደች መንግስት የጣለውን እገዳ በመቃወም ክስ መስርቷል። ቡድኑ በመጪው መስከረም ወር የሚተገበረው እገዳ በክምችት ላይ ያሉትን 20,000 የየወይን ጠጅ ጠርሙሶች ለመሸጥ በቂ ጊዜ እንደማይሰጥ እና የአውሮፓ የነፃ ንግድ ህግን እንደሚጻረር ይከራከራል። የአውሮፓ ህብረት ከእነዚህ ሰፈራዎች ለሚመጡ ምርቶች መለያ ብቻ እንዲለጠፍ ቢጠይቅም፣ የደች መንግስት ግን በራሱ አቅጣጫ ለሚቀጥሉት ሶስት ዓመታት ሙሉ በሙሉ የሚከለክል ህግ አውጥቷል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Kiristaanota Israa'eliif jedhamu kan biyya Neezerlaand, mootummaan biyyattii oomishoota buufataalee Israa'el seeraan alaa kanneen gama dhihaa (West Bank) fi Golan Heights irraa dhufan dhoorkuuf murteesse mormuun mana murtiitti himateera. Gareen kun, dhoorkaan ji'a Fulbaanaatti hojiirra oolu oomisha wayinii 20,000 of harka qaban gurgurachuuf yeroo gahaa akka hin kennine fi seera daldala bilisaa kan Awurooppaa kan cabsu ta'uu falmataa jira. Gamtaan Awurooppaa oomishoota kana irratti mallattoo iddoo itti oomishaman qofa akka godhamu gaafatuus, Neezerlaand garuu waggoota sadan dhufaniif daldala kana guutummaatti dhoorkuuf murteessiteetti.

title: Israel extends campaign against UNRWA to advance West Bank annexation
english: Israeli forces recently raided a UNRWA training facility in East Jerusalem as part of a broader campaign to dismantle international refugee support. Experts believe this move is designed to seize control of the neighboring Qalandiya Airport to construct thousands of new settlement units. This initiative is a strategic step toward the annexation of the West Bank, effectively threatening the territorial integrity and future viability of a Palestinian state.
amharic: የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በቅርቡ በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም የሚገኘውን የተባበሩት መንግስታት የስደተኞች መርጃ ድርጅት (UNRWA) ማሰልጠኛ ማዕከል ወረራ ፈጽመዋል። ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት ይህ ድርጊት አጎራባች የሆነውን የቃላንዲያ አየር ማረፊያ በመቆጣጠር በዚያ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰፈራዎችን ለመገንባት ያለመ ነው። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ የምዕራብ ባንክን የመቀላቀል ስትራቴጂ አካል ሲሆን፣ የፍልስጤም መንግስት የመመስረት እድልን በእጅጉ የሚጎዳ ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el dhiheenya kana buufata leenjii UNRWA kan Yerusaalem bahaa keessatti argamu haleelanii jiru. Akka ogeeyyiin jedhanitti, tarkiinchi kun buufata xiyyaaraa Qalandiyaa to'annoo jala oolchuun mana jireenyaa haaraa kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman ijaaruuf kan karoorfame dha. Tarkiinchi kun lafa Qarqara Lixaa (West Bank) dhuunfachuuf kan karoorfame yoo ta'u, kunis mootummaa Paalastayinii gara fuulduraatti hundeessuuf yaalame irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uuma.

title: Kremlin says CIA head met Russian intelligence officials, but not Putin
english: CIA Director John Ratcliffe recently traveled to Moscow for discussions with Russian intelligence officials. Although he did not meet with President Vladimir Putin, the Kremlin described the engagement as a positive step. This visit marks the first time a CIA leader has held such talks in Russia since 2021, amid ongoing efforts to address diplomatic tensions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የሲአይኤ ዳይሬክተር ጆን ራትክሊፍ በሞስኮ ከሩሲያ የስለላ ባለስልጣናት ጋር ለመወያየት ጉብኝት አድርገዋል። ምንም እንኳን ከፕሬዚዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን ጋር ባይገናኙም፣ የክሬምሊን ቃል አቀባይ ንግግሩን አወንታዊ እርምጃ ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። ይህ ጉብኝት ከ2014 በኋላ የአሜሪካ የስለላ ድርጅት ሃላፊ ወደ ሩሲያ ያደረጉት የመጀመሪያው ጉዞ ሲሆን፣ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን የዲፕሎማሲ ውጥረት ለመቀነስ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Daayreektarri CIA John Ratcliffe magaalaa Moskoo deemanii qondaaltota basaastota Raashiyaa waliin mari’ataniiru. Pirezidaant Vladimir Putin waliin wal-arguun hin jiraanne malee, gartuun biyya bulchu (Kremlin) mariin kun tarkaanfii gaarii akka ta’e ibseera. Daawwannaan kun hogganaan CIA tokko bara 2021 as Raashiyaa yeroo jalqabaaf kan daawwatan yoo ta’u, kunis hariiroo biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru fooyyessuuf yaali godhamuudha.

title: Meta agrees to settlement, platform changes in youth addiction case
english: Meta has reached a settlement of $16.68 billion to resolve a major lawsuit accusing its platforms of harming and addicting young users. As part of the agreement, the company will implement new safety measures, including daily time limits and night-time usage blocks for minors. Additionally, Meta has committed to identifying and removing any children under the age of 13 from Facebook and Instagram.
amharic: ሜታ ማህበራዊ ድረ-ገጾቹ በህጻናት ላይ ሱስን በመፍጠር እና የደህንነት ስጋት በመጋበዝ ተከሰው የነበረውን ክስ ለመፍታት 16.68 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ለመክፈል ተስማምቷል። ስምምነቱ የኩባንያው መድረኮች ለታዳጊዎች ያላቸውን የጊዜ ገደብ መወሰን እና ማታ ማታ እንዳይጠቀሙ የሚከለክሉ እርምጃዎችን ያካትታል። በተጨማሪም ሜታ ከ13 ዓመት በታች የሆኑ ህጻናትን ከፌስቡክ እና ኢንስታግራም መድረኮች የመለየት እና የማስወገድ ስራ ለመስራት ቃል ገብቷል።
oromo: Meta dhaabbanni isaa miidiyaa hawaasummaa (Facebook fi Instagram) ijoollee irratti dhiibbaa fi qabattoo hamaa uumuu isaatiin himatamee ture irratti walii galtee $16.68 biliyoonaa irra ga’eera. Walii galtee kanaan, dhaabbatichi ijoolleen waggaa 18 gadi ta’an guyyaatti sa’aatii lama qofa akka fayyadaman fi halkan akka cufamu gochuun nageenya isaanii eeguuf dirqameera. Kana malees, Meta ijoollee waggaa 13 gadi ta’an adda baasee fuula isaa irraa akka haqamu gochuuf walii galeera.

title: Trump tells Al Jazeera ‘not in a hurry’ for Iran to return to talks
english: US President Donald Trump stated he is not rushing Iran to return to the negotiating table, claiming he has no specific timeline to end the ongoing conflict. He suggested that the current economic pressure on Iran is effective, as the country faces severe inflation and domestic turmoil. This stance marks a significant shift from his earlier predictions that the war would conclude quickly.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኢራን ወደ ድርድር ጠረጴዛ እንድትመለስ ለማድረግ ምንም ዓይነት የጊዜ ገደብ እንደሌላቸው ተናግረዋል። ኢራን ከፍተኛ የዋጋ ግሽበት እና የውስጥ ችግሮች ውስጥ ስላለች ግፊቱ ውጤታማ እንደሆነ ገልጸው፣ ጦርነቱ በፍጥነት ይጠናቀቃል ብለው ቀደም ሲል የነበራቸውን አቋም ለውጠዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Amerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp Itoophiyaan marii irratti akka deebituuf ariifannaa akka hin qabne fi yeroo murtaa'e tokko akka hin kaa'in ibsaniiru. Inni, Itoophiyaan diinagdee cimaa fi rakkoo keessaa keessa waan jirtuuf dhiibbaan sun bu'aa qabaachuu isaa eeraniiru. Ibsi kun, waraanni kun yeroo gabaabaa keessatti akka xumuramu kanaan dura dubbataa turan irraa haala adda ta'een kan dhiyaateedha.

title: Bodies of missing people found in Korea becomes national scandal
english: A South Korean police officer has been taken into custody following the discovery of four missing individuals' remains on Jeju Island. Authorities determined that the officer had neglected to properly investigate these disappearances. Consequently, officials are now re-examining nearly 300 other missing person cases previously managed by the same officer.
amharic: በደቡብ ኮሪያ ጄጁ ደሴት ላይ የአራት የጠፉ ሰዎችን አስከሬን በማግኘቱ አንድ የፖሊስ መኮንን በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። መኮንኑ ጉዳዮቹን በአግባቡ ባለመረመሩ ምክንያት የጠፉ ሰዎችን ጉዳይ መዝገብ በመዝጋቱ ትልቅ ቅሌት ተፈጥሯል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ባለስልጣናት መኮንኑ ሲያጣራባቸው የነበሩትን ሌሎች 298 የጠፉ ሰዎች ጉዳዮች በድጋሚ በመመርመር ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Qondaalli poolisii biyya Kooriyaa Kibbaa tokko, reeffi namoota achi buute isaanii dhabamee ture afur erga manneen Jeju irratti argamanii booda to'annoo jala ooleera. Qondaalli kun qorannoo sirrii ta'e osoo hin gaggeessin dhimmoota kanneen cufuun isaa kutaannoo biyyaalessaa uumeera. Kana hordofuun, bulchiinsi biyyattii qondaala kanaan dura qoratamanii turan dhimmoota namoota dhabamanii 298 ta'an irratti qorannoo irra deebii jalqabaniiru.

title: Children in Gaza fear flying their kites after Israeli threat
english: A young boy in Gaza has stopped flying his handmade kites due to fear following an Israeli warning. Israeli authorities have declared that they will treat kites and balloons launched from the region as military drones or acts of aggression. This policy has effectively turned a common childhood pastime into a dangerous activity for children living in the area.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚኖር አንድ የ10 ዓመት ልጅ እስራኤል በሰጠችው ማስጠንቀቂያ ምክንያት በራሪ ወረቀቶችን ወይም ካይቶችን መብረር አቁሟል። እስራኤል ከጋዛ የሚለቀቁ ካይቶችን እና ፊኛዎችን እንደ ድሮን ወይም የጦርነት ድርጊት እንደምትቆጥራቸው አስታውቃለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የልጆች ተራ መጫወቻ የነበረውን ነገር ወደ አደገኛ ድርጊት ቀይሮታል።
oromo: Mucaan waggaa 10 ta'e tokko kan Gaazaatti argamu, akeekkachiisa Israa'el ergiterratti hundaa'ee kaysii (kite) bal'isuu dhiiseera. Mootummaan Israa'el kaysiiwwan fi buufawwan qilleensaa Gaazaarraa gadhiifaman akka xiyyara nama hin feene (drones) ykn gocha waraanaatti akka ilaalamu ibsiteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun tapha ijoolleen baay'ee jaallatan gara gocha hatattamaa fi balaa qabutti jijjiireera.

title: Heart, hope and a steely determination: Dolly Parton's musical legacy
english: Dolly Parton created her hit song '9 To 5' by using the clicking sound of her acrylic nails to mimic a typewriter while on a movie set. The track became a famous anthem that captured the frustrations of working women and addressed workplace inequality. Beyond its catchy melody, the song reflects Parton's personal experience with industry challenges and her ability to turn deep-seated anger into a powerful, enduring musical legacy.
amharic: ዶሊ ፓርተን ታዋቂውን '9 To 5' የተሰኘ ዘፈኗን የፈጠረችው በፊልም ቀረጻ ወቅት በሰው ሰራሽ ጥፍሮቿ ድምፅ የጽሕፈት መኪና ድምፅ በመፍጠር ነበር። ይህ ዘፈን በሥራ ቦታ የሚገጥሙትን የሴቶች ችግሮች እና ኢ-ፍትሐዊነትን በመግለጽ እንደ መዝሙር ተወዳጅነትን አትርፏል። ዘፈኑ ከዜማው ውበት ባሻገር ፓርተን በሙያው ዘርፍ የገጠሟትን ተግዳሮቶች በማንጸባረቅ፣ የነበረባትን ቁጣ ወደ ጠንካራ የሙዚቃ ስራ የቀየረችበት አስደናቂ ታሪክ አለው።
oromo: Dolly Parton sirba ishee beekamaa '9 To 5' jedhu kan uumte, yeroo filmii hojjettu qeensa ishee sobaa walitti rukutuun sagalee makiinayyee barreessituu fakkeessuudhaan ture. Sirbi kun miira dubartootni bakka hojii keessatti qaban fi qixxummaa dhabuu ibsuudhaan akka faaruu guddaatti fudhatame. Sirbichi irra caalaatti miira boonsaa ta'us, Dolly rakkina industrii keessatti ishee mudataa ture gara sagalee humna qabuufi seenaa qabeessa ta'etti jijjiiruun ishee nama dinqisiisa.

title: A teacher’s slap, student’s death revive India’s corporal punishment debate
english: A six-year-old Indian student named Pranay Teja tragically died after his teacher slapped him for not completing his homework. Although corporal punishment was officially banned in Indian schools over a decade ago, this incident has reignited public debate regarding why such physical abuse remains common. Authorities have launched an investigation into the school as experts point out that current laws are still failing to protect children in many classrooms.
amharic: ፕራናይ ቴጃ የተባለ የስድስት ዓመት የህንድ ተማሪ የቤት ስራውን አልሰራህም በሚል መምህሩ በጥፊ በመታው ምክንያት ህይወቱ ማለፉ ትልቅ ሀዘን ፈጥሯል። ምንም እንኳን በህንድ ትምህርት ቤቶች አካላዊ ቅጣት ከታገደ ከአስር ዓመት በላይ ቢሆንም፣ ይህ ክስተት እንዲህ አይነት ጥቃቶች አሁንም በስፋት የሚፈጸሙት ለምንድን ነው የሚለውን ክርክር አነሳስቷል። ባለስልጣናት በትምህርት ቤቱ ላይ ምርመራ የጀመሩ ሲሆን፣ ህጉ በብዙ ተማሪዎች ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን በደል መከላከል አለመቻሉ በባለሙያዎች እየተነሳ ነው።
oromo: Barataan umuriin isaa waggaa jahaa ta'e kan maqaan isaa Pranay Teja jedhamu, hojii manaa waan hin xumurreef barsiisaan isaa erga reebnee booda du'uun isaa gadda guddaa uumeera. India keessatti adabbiin qaamaa mana barumsaa keessatti erga dhorkamee waggoota kudhan darbanis, taateen kun maaliif reebichi amma iyyuu amala baramaa ta'ee akka jiru gaaffii guddaa uumeera. Abbootiin taayitaa manneen barnootaa irratti qorannoo eegalanis, seeronni amma jiran ijoollee eeguuf gahaa akka hin taane ogeeyyoonni ni ibsu.

title: ICC chief urges Japan to counter US pressure on the court
english: International Criminal Court President Tomoko Akane has requested that Japan resist United States pressure to weaken the institution. Washington recently imposed sanctions on Akane and other court officials while actively encouraging member nations to withdraw their support. Akane emphasized that Japan's diplomatic influence and its role as a major financial contributor are essential to protecting the court from these external challenges.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ፕሬዝዳንት ቶሞኮ አካኔ ጃፓን በአሜሪካ የሚደረገውን ጫና በመቋቋም ፍርድ ቤቱን እንድትደግፍ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ዋሽንግተን በቅርቡ በአካኔ እና በሌሎች የፍርድ ቤቱ ባለስልጣናት ላይ ማዕቀብ የጣለች ሲሆን፣ አባል ሀገራት ከፍርድ ቤቱ እንዲወጡ ግፊት እያደረገች ትገኛለች። ፕሬዝዳንቷ ጃፓን ያላትን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ተጽእኖ በመጠቀም ፍርድ ቤቱን ከዚህ ጫና ለመጠበቅ የበኩሏን ድርሻ እንድትወጣ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Mana Maree Yakka Adunyaa (ICC) Tookomoo Akaaneen, biyyi Jaappaan dhiibbaa mootummaan Ameerikaa dhaabbaticha irratti godhu akka qolattu gaafataniiru. Waashingitan dhiheenya kana Akaanee fi hojjettoota mana marichaa irratti ergaa gadhiisteen booda, biyyoonni miseensa ta'an akka mana maricha keessaa bahan dirqisiisaa jirti. Akaaneen, Jaappaan dhiibbaa siyaasaa fi gargaarsa maallaqaa guddaa waan qabduuf, mana marichi dhiibbaa kana injifatee akka itti fufuuf deeggarsa gochuu akka qabdu ibsaniiru.

title: Hundreds of academics and lawyers urge Burnham to lift Palestine Action ban
english: Over 250 prominent lawyers and academics have sent a letter to UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham demanding an end to military aid for Israel and the removal of the terrorist designation for Palestine Action. The signatories argue that the government is failing its international legal obligations by suppressing political protest instead of addressing allegations of genocide in Gaza. They are calling for an immediate halt to all arms exports and security partnerships while urging the government to protect the right to protest and support international judicial efforts against Israeli officials.
amharic: ከ250 በላይ የሚሆኑ የሕግ ባለሙያዎች እና ምሁራን የብሪታኒያ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም ለእስራኤል የሚደረገውን ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ እንዲያቆሙ እና የፓለስቲን አክሽን (Palestine Action) ድርጅትን የሽብር ቡድንነት እንዲያነሱ ጠይቀዋል። የደብዳቤው አስተያባባሪዎች መንግስት በጋዛ እየተፈጸመ ያለውን የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ችላ በማለት፣ ሰላማዊ ተቃውሞ የሚያሰሙ ዜጎችን መቅጣቱ ዓለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጻረር መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በመሆኑም የብሪታንያ መንግስት ከእስራኤል ጋር ያለውን የጦር መሳሪያ እና የደህንነት ትብብር በአስቸኳይ እንዲያቋርጥ እና የመናገርና የመሰብሰብ መብትን እንዲያከብር አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Ogeeyyonni seeraa fi barsiisonni yuuniversitii 250 ol ta'an, muummichi ministeeraa Biritaaniyaa Andy Burnham gargaarsa waraanaa Israa'el irratti godhamu dhaabuu fi dhaabbatichi 'Palestine Action' jedhamu maqaa garee shororkeessaa irraa akka ka'u gaafataniiru. Mallatteessitoonni kunneen, mootummaan yakka sanyii balleessii Gaazaa keessatti raawwatamaa jiru dhaabsisuu mannaa, namoota mormii dhageessisan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuun isaa seera idil-addunyaa cabsuu akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Mootummaan Biritaaniyaa meeshaalee waraanaa fi tumsa nageenyaa Israa'el waliin qabu akka dhaabu akkasumas mirga yaada ibsachuu fi hiriira ba'uu akka kabaju cimsanii gaafataniiru.

title: Turkey recruits Trump insiders for new Washington lobbying push
english: The Turkish government has signed a one-year, $2.4 million contract with Ballard Partners, a lobbying firm with strong connections to President Donald Trump, to represent its interests in Washington. Ankara is primarily seeking assistance to rejoin the F-35 fighter jet program after being excluded for purchasing Russian military equipment. The firm's team includes experienced political figures, such as former congressman Robert Wexler and former Trump aide Thomas Boodry, to help navigate US policy and congressional relations.
amharic: የቱርክ መንግስት ከፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጋር የቅርብ ግንኙነት ካለው 'ባላርድ ፓርትነርስ' ከተባለ የሎቢ ድርጅት ጋር ለአንድ አመት የሚቆይ የ2.4 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ስምምነት ተፈራርሟል። አንካራ ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደችው ከሩሲያ በተገዛው የኤስ-400 መከላከያ ስርዓት ምክንያት ከተባረረችበት የኤፍ-35 የጦር አውሮፕላን ፕሮግራም መልሳ ለመቀላቀል ነው። የድርጅቱ ቡድን በአሜሪካ ፖሊሲ እና በኮንግረስ ጉዳዮች ላይ ተፅዕኖ ለመፍጠር ልምድ ያላቸውን የቀድሞ የኮንግረስ አባል ሮበርት ዌክስለርን እና የቀድሞውን የትራምፕ ረዳት ቶማስ ቡድሪን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ ባለሙያዎችን አካቷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Turkey dhaabbata 'Ballard Partners' jedhamu, kan hariiroo cimaa pirezidaant Donald Traamp wajjin qabu waliin, waggaa tokkoof mallaqa doolaara miliyoona 2.4 ta'uun waliigaltee mallatteesseera. Ankara tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatte, meeshaa waraana Raashiyaa bituu ishee irraa kan ka'e sagantaa xiyyaara waraana F-35 keessaa erga ari'amtee booda, deebitee sagantichatti makamuufi. Gareen dhaabbatichaa kun dhimma siyaasaafi hariiroo waajjiraalee mootummaa Ameerikaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuuf, miseensa koongrasii duraanii Robert Wexler fi gargaaraa Traamp duraanii Thomas Boodry dabalatee ogeeyyota muuxannoo qaban qabateera.

title: Deadly flash floods sweep through northern Nepal
english: Devastating flash floods in northern Nepal have resulted in at least eight deaths and the destruction of numerous homes. Large amounts of debris and mud have swept through mountain villages, leaving hundreds of people unaccounted for. Local authorities are currently working to evaluate the full extent of the disaster and conduct rescue operations.
amharic: በሰሜናዊ ኔፓል በተከሰተው ድንገተኛ የጎርፍ አደጋ ቢያንስ ስምንት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል እንዲሁም በርካታ ቤቶች ወድመዋል። ጎርፉ ጭቃና ደለል በመያዝ በተራራማ አካባቢ የሚገኙ መንደሮችን በማጥለቅለቁ በብዙ መቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች የት እንደደረሱ አልታወቀም። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት በአሁኑ ወቅት የደረሰውን ጉዳት መጠን በመገምገም ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Kaaba Neepaalitti balaa lolaa tasaa kanaan lubbuun namoota saddeet darbuun ala manneen jireenyaa hedduun manca'aniiru. Loli kun biyyee fi dhoqqee wajjin mandeewwan gaarreen jiran keessa waan darbeef, namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman bakka buuteen isaanii dhabameera. Aangeyyoonni naannichaa amma miidhaa gahuu isaatiin walqabatee qorannoo gochaa jiru.

title: CCTV captures terrifying mudslide engulfing Nepal-China border
english: A massive mudslide recently struck a border crossing between Nepal and China, destroying roads, buildings, and vehicles. Security camera footage captured the frightening moment as people scrambled to escape the oncoming debris. The disaster, triggered by heavy rainfall and flash floods, has resulted in at least nine deaths with many others still missing.
amharic: በኔፓል እና በቻይና ድንበር ላይ የተከሰተ አውዳሚ የመሬት መንሸራተት መንገዶችን፣ ሕንፃዎችን እና ተሽከርካሪዎችን ጠራርጎ ወስዷል። የደህንነት ካሜራዎች ሰዎች ከአደጋው ለማምለጥ ሲሯሯጡ የሚያሳይ አስፈሪ ምስል ቀርጸዋል። በከባድ ዝናብ እና በጎርፍ ምክንያት በተፈጠረው በዚህ አደጋ ቢያንስ ዘጠኝ ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው ያለፈ ሲሆን፣ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ደግሞ የደረሱበት አልታወቀም።
oromo: Mudhiin lafaa guddaan daangaa Nepaalii fi Chaayinaa gidduutti argamurratti mudatee, daandiiwwan, manneenii fi konkolaattota barbadeesseera. Suuraan kaameeraa nageenyaa, namoonni balaa kana jalaa ba'uuf yeroo gabaabaa keessatti ariifachaa jiran agarsiiseera. Roobni cimaa fi loolli uumame balaa kana hordofsiiseera; hanga ammaa namoonni sagal du'anii, dhibboonni immoo bakka bu'an waan hin beekneef barbaadamaa jiru.

title: When is the Champions League draw, which teams are in, and what are the dates?
english: The 2026-2027 UEFA Champions League draw takes place on August 27 in Monaco, featuring 36 teams divided into four pots. Under the current format, every club will compete against eight different opponents in the league phase running from September to January. The tournament will then progress to knockout stages, culminating in the final match at Atletico Madrid's stadium in early June.
amharic: የ2026-2027 የቻምፒዮንስ ሊግ የዕጣ አወጣጥ በሞናኮ ነሐሴ 27 ቀን የሚካሄድ ሲሆን፣ 36 ቡድኖች በአራት ምድቦች ተከፋፍለው ይሳተፋሉ። አዲሱ የውድድር ስልት እያንዳንዱ ቡድን ከሴፕቴምበር እስከ ጥር ድረስ በሊግ ደረጃ ከስምንት የተለያዩ ተቀናቃኞች ጋር እንዲጫወት ያደርጋል። ውድድሩ በማንኳኳት ዙር ቀጥሎ በሰኔ ወር መጀመሪያ ላይ በአትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ ስታዲየም በሚደረገው ፍጻሜ ይጠናቀቃል።
oromo: Guyyaan sagantaa fiixee tapha Champions League bara 2026-2027 Hagayya 27 Monakootti kan raawwatamu yoo ta'u, gareewwan 36 sadarkaalee afur keessatti qoodamanii hirmaatu. Haala haaraa kanaan, garee hundi ji'a Fulbaana irraa hanga Amajjiitti taphataan 8 adda addaa waliin wal morkatu. Taphoonni kunneen booda gara sadarkaa dursaa fiixee (knockout) kan darban yoo ta'u, xumura isaa ji'a Waxabajjii jalqabaa buufata taphaa Atleetikoo Maadriiditti ni geggeeffama.

title: Photos: Avalanche floods kill eight, hundreds missing in Nepal’s Himalayas
english: A massive avalanche of ice and rock in Nepal’s Himalayan region has triggered devastating flash floods, claiming at least eight lives. Hundreds of people, including many international tourists, remain missing as the rushing water destroyed villages, roads, and power infrastructure. The government is seeking international assistance for rescue operations as experts warn that climate change is increasing the risk of such disasters.
amharic: በኔፓል የሂማላያ ተራራማ አካባቢ በበረዶና በድንጋይ መደርመስ ምክንያት በተከሰተ ከፍተኛ ጎርፍ ቢያንስ ስምንት ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን አጥተዋል። በጎርፉ የተነሳ ብዙ መንደሮችና መሰረተ ልማቶች በመውደማቸው በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች፣ የውጭ ዜጎችን ጨምሮ የደረሱበት አልታወቀም። መንግስት በአደጋው የጠፉ ሰዎችን ለመፈለግ አለማቀፍ ድጋፍ የጠየቀ ሲሆን፣ ባለሙያዎች የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ እንዲህ ያሉ አደጋዎችን እያባባሰ መሆኑን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Naannoo gaara Himaalaayaa kan Neppaalitti, dhokaan caba cabbii fi dhagaa irraa uumame balaa lolaa cimaa geessiseen namoonni yoo xiqqaate saddeet lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Bishaan lolaa kun ganda, daandiiwwan fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa hedduu waan barbadeesseef, namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman keessattuu tuuristoonni biyyoota alaa hedduun iddoo buuteen isaanii dhabameera. Mootummaan Neppaal hojii barbaachaaf gargaarsa idil-addunyaa gaafateera; ogeeyyonni immoo jijjiiramni qilleensaa balaa akkasii dabaluu isaa akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: England footballer Sterling charged with dangerous driving after collision
english: Former England football star Raheem Sterling faces legal charges following a solo car accident on a UK motorway in May. Police have accused the 31-year-old of dangerous driving, improper possession of nitrous oxide, and failing to provide a specimen. He is scheduled to attend a court hearing regarding these charges on September 15.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ እግር ኳስ ኮከብ የነበረው ራሂም ስተርሊንግ ባለፈው ግንቦት ወር በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም በደረሰው የአውቶሞቢል አደጋ ምክንያት ክስ ተመሰረተበት። የፖሊስ ባለስልጣናት ስተርሊንግ በግዴለሽነት ማሽከርከር፣ ህገ-ወጥ የናይትረስ ኦክሳይድ ይዞታ እና ለምርመራ ናሙና አለመስጠት ወንጀሎች እንደሚጠረጠር ገልጸዋል። ተጫዋቹ በእነዚህ ክሶች ዙሪያ መስከረም 15 ቀን ፍርድ ቤት ቀርቦ ይከራከራል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Taphataan kubbaa miilaa biyya Ingiliz Raahim Sterliing, baatii Caamsaa darbe biyya Ingilizitti konkolaataasaa balaaf ergeen booda himatameera. Poolisiin akka ibsetti, umriin isaa 31 ta'e kun konkolaataa nagaa booressuun oofuu, qoricha 'nitrous oxide' seeraan ala qabachuu fi qormaataf yaadannoo dhabamsiisuun himatameera. Himannoo kanneenirratti dhiyaachuufis guyyaa 15 Sadaasaa (September) mana murtiitti akka dhiyaatu beekameera.

title: Israeli strike on Gaza displacement camp kills one, pregnant woman wounded
english: An Israeli military attack on a displacement camp in Mawasi, Khan Younis, resulted in at least one fatality and multiple injuries. In a separate incident, a pregnant woman was reported wounded following an airstrike on the Jabalia refugee camp in northern Gaza. These events highlight the ongoing violence affecting civilians seeking refuge in various parts of the territory.
amharic: በካን ዩኒስ ማዋሲ በተፈናቃዮች መጠለያ ካምፕ ላይ በእስራኤል በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ቢያንስ አንድ ሰው ሲሞት ሌሎች በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። በሌላ በኩል በሰሜናዊ ጋዛ በሚገኘው የጃባሊያ ስደተኞች ካምፕ ላይ በተሰነዘረ ጥቃት አንዲት ነፍሰ ጡር ሴት መቁሰሏ ተዘግቧል። እነዚህ ክስተቶች በተለያዩ የጋዛ አካባቢዎች ለስደተኞች ጥቃት እየደረሰ መሆኑን ያመለክታሉ።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el buufata buqqaatonni keessa jiraatan kan Mawasi, Khan Younis jedhamu irratti haleellaa raawwataniin namni tokko yoo du'u, namoonni biroo hedduun madaa'aniiru. Kana malees, gamoo Kaaba Gaazaatti argamu kan Jabaaliyaa irratti haleellaa raawwatameeniin dubartiin ulfti tokko miidhamuun gabaasameera. Haleellaan kunneen namoota bakka buqqa'anii dahoo barbaadachaa jiran irratti miidhaan gahaa jiraachuu kan agarsiisanidha.

title: Iran-Oman Hormuz agreement not yet finalised: Iranian source
english: Despite recent reports suggesting a deal was complete, an Iranian official has clarified that negotiations between Iran and Oman regarding the Strait of Hormuz are still ongoing. Both nations are currently working to finalize specific details concerning territorial shares and revenue distribution. The discussions remain a work in progress rather than a fully signed agreement.
amharic: ኢራን እና ኦማን በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት የባህር ድርሻ እና ገቢ ክፍፍል ላይ ስምምነት ላይ ደርሰዋል ተብሎ ቢዘገብም፣ የኢራን ባለስልጣን ስምምነቱ ገና አልተጠናቀቀም ብለዋል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት አሁንም በዝርዝር ጉዳዮች ላይ እየተወያዩ ይገኛሉ። እስካሁን ድረስ ሙሉ በሙሉ የተፈረመ ስምምነት የለም።
oromo: Iraanii fi Omaan walii galtee daangaa galaana Hormuz fi qooda galii irratti ga’aniiru jedhamee gabaasamee tureyyu, aangoonni Iraan tokko garuu mariin sun ammallee akka hin xumuramin ibsaniiru. Biyyoonni lameen kun hanga ammaatti ragaalee fi haala qoodinsa galii irratti mari’achaa jiru. Walii galtichi hanga ammaatti guutummatti hin mallatteeffamne.

title: Canada bars Jerusalem deputy mayor Arieh King from entering country over war crimes complaints
english: Canadian officials have denied entry to West Jerusalem Deputy Mayor Arieh King, effectively canceling his planned speaking tour in Toronto and Montreal. This decision followed intense pressure and a formal criminal complaint from human rights organizations, who accused him of involvement in war crimes and the illegal displacement of Palestinians. King, known for his controversial anti-Palestinian rhetoric and support for settlement expansion, was blocked based on concerns regarding his complicity in crimes against humanity.
amharic: የካናዳ ባለስልጣናት የምዕራብ እየሩሳሌም ምክትል ከንቲባ አርየህ ኪንግ ወደ ሀገሪቱ እንዳይገቡ በመከልከል በቶሮንቶ እና ሞንትሪያል ሊያደርጉት የነበረውን ጉብኝት ሰርዘውታል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች በጦር ወንጀል እና ፍልስጤማውያንን ከቀያቸው በማፈናቀል ድርጊት ላይ ተሳትፎ እንዳለው በይፋ ከከሰሱት በኋላ ነው። ኪንግ በፀረ-ፍልስጤም አስተያየቶቹ እና በሰፈራ መስፋፋት ላይ ባለው አቋም የሚታወቅ ሲሆን፣ በሰው ልጆች ላይ በሚፈጸሙ ወንጀሎች ተባባሪ ሊሆን ይችላል በሚል ስጋት እንዲታገድ ተደርጓል።
oromo: Mootummaan Kanaadaa itti-aanaa kantiibaa Yerusaalem-Dhihaa Arieh King biyyattii akka hin seenne dhorkuudhaan, karoora isaa kan gara Toronto fi Montreal deemuuf qabate akka haqu taasiseera. Murtiin kun kan darbe, dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa fi gargaarsa seeraa isaan irratti himata dhiyeessanii fi yakka waraanaa fi buqqisuu fiilistumootaa irratti hirmaateera jechuun dhiibbaa godhaniin booda dha. King yaada fiilistumoota mormu fi babal'ina naannawa manneen jireenyaa Israa'el deeggaruudhaan kan beekamu yoo ta'u, yakka namoomaa irratti hirmaachuun isaa shakkamee akka hin seenne ta'eera.

title: Trump’s ‘economic D-Day’ tests Iran’s trading ties across the region
english: The United States has introduced new sanctions aimed at isolating Iran’s economy after failed peace negotiations and the closure of a 60-day window. These measures threaten to cut off any country trading with Iran from the US financial system, though the administration has yet to penalize key partners like China. While Iran claims it is prepared to withstand this pressure, its oil exports have already dropped to zero due to a naval blockade, significantly worsening the country's economic crisis.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግሥት በኢራን ላይ የሰላም ድርድሩ መክሸፉን ተከትሎ አዳዲስ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ማዕቀቦችን ጥሏል። እነዚህ ማዕቀቦች ከኢራን ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነት የሚያደርጉ ሀገራት ከአሜሪካ የፋይናንስ ሥርዓት እንደሚታገዱ ያስጠነቅቃሉ። ምንም እንኳን ኢራን ለዚህ ጫና ዝግጁ እንደሆነች ብትገልጽም፣ በባህር ዳርቻዎቿ ላይ በተጣለ የጦር መርከቦች እገዳ ምክንያት የነዳጅ ንግዷ ሙሉ በሙሉ በመቆሙ ሀገሪቱ ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ውስጥ ገብታለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa mariin nagaa erga fashaleen booda diinagdee Iraan addaan kutuuf tarkaanfii sanadaa haaraa fudhateera. Sanadoonni kun biyyoota Iraan wajjin daldalan sirna faayinaansii Ameerikaa irraa akka cufaman akeekkachiisu. Iraan dhiibbaa kana dandamachuuf qophiidha jettee kan dubbattu ta’us, sababa duula markaboota waraanaatiin gabaan boba’aa ishee guutummaatti waan dhaabateef biyyattiin rakkoo diinagdee hamaa keessa seenteetti.

title: How Islamophobia has become Israel's Trojan Horse to win over westerners
english: Israel's Diaspora Affairs Minister Amichai Chikli has openly admitted to using Islamophobia as a strategic tool to gain political support in Western nations. By framing Israel as a frontline defender of 'Judeo-Christian' values against perceived threats, the government aims to leverage fear of Muslims to bolster its own standing. This strategy involves building alliances with far-right populist groups across Europe, effectively shifting the ministry's role from protecting Jewish communities to weaponizing xenophobia.
amharic: የእስራኤል የዳያስፖራ ጉዳዮች ሚኒስትር አማቻይ ቺክሊ በምዕራባውያን አገራት የፖለቲካ ድጋፍ ለማግኘት እስልምናን መፍራት (ኢስላሞፎቢያን) እንደ ስልት እንደሚጠቀሙ በግልጽ ተናግረዋል። እስራኤልን በ'አይሁድ-ክርስቲያን' እሴቶች ላይ የተቃጣውን አደጋ ለመከላከል እንደ ግንባር ቀደም አገር በማቅረብ፣ መንግስታቸው በሙስሊሞች ላይ ያለውን ስጋት ለራሱ ጥቅም ለማዋል እየሰራ ነው። ይህ አካሄድ ከአውሮፓ እጅግ በጣም ቀኝ አክራሪ ቡድኖች ጋር ጥምረት በመፍጠር፣ የሚኒስቴሩን ዋና አላማ የአይሁድ ማህበረሰብን ከመጠበቅ ወደ ፖለቲካዊ መጠቀሚያነት የለወጠ ነው።
oromo: Ministeerri dhimma dhiyaaspooraa Israa'el Amichaay Chiikli, biyyoota dhihaa keessatti deggarsa siyaasaa argachuuf jecha jibba Islaamummaa (Islamophobia) akka meeshaa tarsiimoo tokkotti itti fayyadamaa akka jiran ifatti dubbataniiru. Israa'el duudhaa 'Judeo-Christian' eeguuf akka humnatti of dhiheessuudhaan, mootummaan isaanii soda namoota Muslimoota irra jiru fayyadamanii siyaasa isaanii cimsuuf yaalu. Tarsiimoon kun dhaabbilee farra-godantootaa kanneen Awurooppaa keessa jiran wajjin michummaa uumuu dhaan, hojii ministeerichaa kan duraan hawaasa Yihuudii eeguu ture gara meeshaa siyaasaatti jijjiiree jira.

title: Central Bank Writes Rulebooks for Billion-Birr Market Already Exists
english: The National Bank of Ethiopia is developing a new regulatory framework to govern the rapidly growing interest-free banking sector. This strategy aims to standardize tax policies, introduce Islamic financial tools like Sukuk, and establish a national Sharia oversight board. These rules are expected to help existing interest-free banking services within conventional banks evolve into independent, fully regulated financial institutions.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ ባንክ በፍጥነት እያደገ ላለው የወለድ አልባ የባንክ አገልግሎት አዲስ የአሠራር መመሪያ እያዘጋጀ ነው። ይህ ስትራቴጂ የወለድ አልባ የፋይናንስ አገልግሎትን ከሌሎች የባንክ አገልግሎቶች ጋር እኩል የግብር ሥርዓት እንዲኖረው ከማድረጉም በላይ፣ የሱኩክ ቦንድን ለማስተዋወቅ እና ሀገራዊ የሸሪዓ ተገዢነት ቁጥጥር ሥርዓትን ለመዘርጋት ያለመ ነው። ይህ መመሪያ በተለመዱ ባንኮች ውስጥ ያሉ የወለድ አልባ የባንክ ክፍሎች ወደ ሙሉ የፋይናንስ ተቋማትነት እንዲያድጉ ይረዳቸዋል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Baankiin Biyyaalessaa Itoophiyaa damee baankii dhala-bilisaa saffisaan guddatuuf seera haaraa baasuuf qophaa’aa jira. Karoorri kun tajaajilli faayinaansii shari’aa irratti hundaa’e gibira irratti qixxee akka ilaalamu, meeshaalee faayinaansii akka ‘Sukuk’ akka jiraatan fi qaamni biyyaalessaa shari’aa to’atu akka hundaa’u taasisa. Seeronni kun tajaajiloota baankii dhala-bilisaa kanneen baankiiwwan idilee keessatti argaman gara dhaabbilee walaba ta’anitti akka guddatan gargaara.

title: The City Wants to Widen Its Tax Net. Shops Feel It Tighten
english: The Addis Abeba City Administration is aggressively increasing tax assessments for small businesses to reach a massive half-trillion-Birr revenue goal. Many shop owners report that their tax bills have tripled or quadrupled, putting immense financial strain on their operations. Business owners feel the current system unfairly targets established taxpayers rather than expanding the net to include those currently unregistered.
amharic: የአዲስ አበባ ከተማ አስተዳደር ግማሽ ትሪሊዮን ብር የገቢ ግብ ለመሰብሰብ በማሰብ በትንንሽ ንግድ ተቋማት ላይ የግብር ምዘናውን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምሯል። በርካታ ነጋዴዎች የግብር መጠኑ ከአራት እጥፍ በላይ እንደጨመረባቸው በመግለጽ የንግድ ስራቸውን ለማስቀጠል ተቸግረናል ብለዋል። ነጋዴዎች አዲሱ አሰራር አዳዲስ ከፋዮችን ከማካተት ይልቅ ቀድሞውንም በስርዓቱ ውስጥ ያሉትን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ የሚጫን መሆኑን በመተቸት ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Bulchiinsi magaalaa Finfinnee galii walakkaa tiriliyoona tokkoo guutuuf jecha gibira daldaltoota xixiqqoo irratti qabu gara dachaa afuriitti dabaleera. Daldaltoonni hedduun gatiin gibiraa kun dandeettii isaanii ol ta'uu fi hojii isaanii itti fufsiisuun ulfaataa akka ta'e dubbatu. Daldaltoonni kun, mootummaan namoota gibira hin kaffalle gara hawaasa gibira kaffaluutti fiduu mannaa, kanneen kaffalaa turan irratti ba'aa ulfaataa fe'uun isaanii sirrii miti jechuun komatu.

title: Wegagen Capital Cuts Reserve as It Reaches for More Capital
english: Wegagen Capital Investment Bank has decided to significantly lower its annual legal reserve from 25% of its profits to 5%. This change, approved by shareholders, moves the company away from commercial banking practices to better align with its specific industry requirements. While this decision provides more immediate capital for growth, financial analysts note that it will slow the accumulation of the company's long-term reserve funds.
amharic: ወጋገን ካፒታል ኢንቨስትመንት ባንክ ዓመታዊ የሕግ ክምችቱን ከትርፉ 25 በመቶ ወደ 5 በመቶ ዝቅ ለማድረግ ወስኗል። ባለአክሲዮኖች በአንድ ድምፅ ያጸደቁት ይህ ውሳኔ ባንኩ ከንግድ ባንኮች አሠራር በመውጣት ለኢንቨስትመንት ዘርፉ ተስማሚ በሆነ መንገድ እንዲንቀሳቀስ ያስችለዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ለባንኩ ዕድገት ፈጣን የገንዘብ አቅም ቢፈጥርም፣ የረጅም ጊዜ የባንኩን የካፒታል ክምችት ግን ቀስ በቀስ እንዲያድግ ያደርገዋል።
oromo: Baankiin Invesimantii Wegagen Capital, kuufama qabeenya seeraa waggaa bu'aa irraa qabu dhibbeentaa 25 irraa gara dhibbeentaa 5tti gadi hir'isuuf murteesseera. Murtoon kun kan ragga'e yoo ta'u, baankichi hojii isaa akkaataa seera daldalaatti foyyeessuuf kan gargaaruudha. Tarkaanfiin kun guddina baankichaaf qabeenya yeroo gabaabaa keessatti dabalataa argamsiisuu danda'us, kuufama qabeenya yeroo dheeraa baankichaa gadi hir'isuu akka danda'u ibsameera.

title: Judges Keep Sandford Students in Their Seats as the Fee War Escalates
english: The Federal High Court has issued an injunction preventing Sandford International School from expelling over 230 students due to an ongoing tuition fee dispute. The core of the conflict involves parents refusing to pay fees at the school's requested exchange rate, arguing that tuition should be settled in Birr rather than dollars. The court order ensures that these students can remain enrolled while the legal battle over fee structures and compliance with national regulations continues.
amharic: የፌደራል ከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት ሳንድፎርድ ኢንተርናሽናል ትምህርት ቤት የትምህርት ክፍያ ውዝግብ ባለባቸው ከ230 በላይ ተማሪዎች ላይ የትምህርት ዕድል እንዳያቋርጥ አግዷል። ግጭቱ የተፈጠረው ወላጆች በትምህርት ቤቱ የተጠየቀውን የውጭ ምንዛሪ ተመን ለመክፈል ፈቃደኛ ባለመሆናቸው እና ክፍያው በዶላር ሳይሆን በብር መሆን አለበት በሚል መከራከሪያ ነው። የፍርድ ቤቱ ትእዛዝ የክፍያ አወቃቀሩ እና የህግ ተገዢነት ክርክሩ እስከሚጠናቀቅ ድረስ ተማሪዎቹ በትምህርት ገበታቸው እንዲቆዩ አድርጓል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa federaalaa, manneen barnootaa Sandford International School barattoota 230 ol ta'an kaffaltii barnootaa waliin walqabatee akka hin ariine dhorkeera. Falmiin kun kan ka'e warreen barattootaa kaffaltiin barnootaa doolaaraan osoo hin taane birriin akka raawwatamu barbaadaniifi kaffaltii manni barnootichaa gaafate irratti walii galuu dadhabuu isaaniitiin dha. Ajajni mana murtiichaa falmiin seeraa ilaalchisee kaffaltii fi seera biyyattii irratti taasifamu hamma xumuramuutti, barattoonni kun barnoota isaanii akka itti fufan mirkaneesseera.

title: Fed Tests a Payment Window for the Whole Government, Starting with Health
english: The Ethiopian government is launching a pilot project in the health sector to centralize all public service payments into a single digital platform. This new system will allow citizens to pay for government services using their preferred bank or mobile payment method, replacing the current fragmented approach. By 2029, the initiative aims to connect all government institutions to this unified infrastructure to simplify and streamline financial transactions.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት የመንግስት አገልግሎት ክፍያዎችን በአንድ የዲጂታል መድረክ ለማቀናጀት በጤናው ዘርፍ የሙከራ ፕሮጀክት ጀምሯል። ይህ አዲስ አሰራር ዜጎች የሚፈልጉትን የባንክ ወይም የዲጂታል ክፍያ አማራጭ በመጠቀም ክፍያዎችን እንዲፈጽሙ ያስችላቸዋል። ፕሮጀክቱ አሁን ያለውን የተበታተነ አሰራር በመቀየር እስከ እ.ኤ.አ 2029 ድረስ ሁሉንም የመንግስት ተቋማት በአንድ የጋራ መሠረተ ልማት ለማገናኘት አቅዷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Itoophiyaa kaffaltii tajaajila mootummaa hunda karaa tokkoon raawwachuuf gamtaan eegaluuf oolee yaaliin fayyaa irratti eegalameera. Sirni haaraan kun lammiileen baankii ykn haala itti fayyadama kaffaltii barbaadan fayyadamanii tajaajila mootummaa akka kaffalan taasisa. Hojiin kun sirna amma jiru kan wal hin qabanne ture hafee, hanga bara 2029 tti dhaabbilee mootummaa hunda sirna kana waliin wal-qabsiisuuf kan karoorfameedha.

title: Door was locked at Pakistan hospital where fire killed 14 babies, witnesses say
english: A tragic fire at a maternity ward in Islamabad's Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences resulted in the death of 14 newborn babies. Eyewitnesses reported that the ward doors were locked during the emergency, hindering rescue efforts and delaying professional help. Families and survivors have heavily criticized the hospital for its poor safety protocols, lack of fire equipment, and the apparent absence of staff during the crisis.
amharic: በኢስላማባድ በሚገኘው የፓኪስታን የሕክምና ሳይንስ ተቋም (PIMS) የወሊድ ክፍል በተነሳ የእሳት አደጋ 14 አዲስ የተወለዱ ሕፃናት ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። የአይን እማኞች እንደገለጹት፣ አደጋው በተከሰተበት ወቅት የሕክምና ክፍሉ በሮች ተቆልፈው ስለነበር የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን አስቸጋሪ አድርጓል። የተጎጂ ቤተሰቦች ሆስፒታሉ የደህንነት መጠበቂያ መሳሪያዎች እንዳልነበሩትና በወቅቱ የነበሩ የሕክምና ባለሙያዎችም በሥራ ቦታቸው አለመገኘታቸውን በመግለጽ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል።
oromo: Buufata fayyaa Paakistaan (PIMS) kan magaalaa Islaamaabaaditti argamu keessatti ibidda ka'een daa'imman haaraa dhalatan 14 du'aniiru. Namoonni ijaan argan akka jedhanitti, yeroo ibiddisaa kanatti kutaaleen daa'immanii cufaa waan turaniif gargaarsa gochuun ulfaataa ture. Maatiin miidhaan irra ga'e, buufata fayyaa kana keessatti meeshaaleen ibidda dhaamsuu akka hin jirre fi yeroo balaan kun gahu ogeeyyonni fayyaa bakka sana akka hin turre himuun komataniiru.

title: Mother and daughter detained by ICE in hospital after car crash
english: An Ecuadorian mother and her teenage daughter were taken into custody by immigration authorities while receiving medical care at a Florida hospital following a vehicle accident. Officials detained the pair after discovering that their legal visas had lapsed despite their ongoing asylum applications. This incident has raised concerns regarding the detention of individuals while they are seeking necessary medical treatment.
amharic: የኢኳዶር እናት እና የ19 ዓመት ልጇ በደረሰባቸው የመኪና አደጋ ምክንያት ፍሎሪዳ በሚገኝ ሆስፒታል ህክምና እየተከታተሉ ሳሉ በኢሚግሬሽን ባለስልጣናት ቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። ባለስልጣናቱ የጥገኝነት ጥያቄያቸው በሂደት ላይ ቢሆንም የቪዛ ጊዜያቸው ማብቃቱን በመጥቀስ እናቷንና ልጇን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋቸዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በህክምና ላይ ያሉ ሰዎችን ማሰር አግባብ መሆን አለመሆኑን በተመለከተ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Haati fi intalli ishee lammiileen Ekuwadoor ta'an, balaa konkolaataa booda hospitaala Filooriidaa keessatti wal'aansa fayyaa argachaa jiranitti mootummaa Ameerikaa kutaalee haajaa godaantotaatiin to'annoo jala oolan. Qaamoleen mootummaa kun, gaaffiin isaanii kan eeyyama baqattummaa dhimmi isaa ilaalamaa jiru ta'us, viizaan isaanii akka dhumate erga mirkaneeffatanii booda hidhaniiru. Gochi kun namoonni yeroo wal'aansa fayyaa argatanitti to'annoo jala ooluun isaanii gaaffii guddaa uumee jira.

title: Photos: Thousands join Spain’s La Tomatina festival for epic tomato battle
english: Around 20,000 people gathered in the Spanish town of Buñol to participate in the annual La Tomatina festival. During the event, participants threw 165 tonnes of overripe tomatoes at each other while enjoying music in the streets. The tradition, which began in 1945, has since grown into a major international tourist attraction.
amharic: በስፔን ቡኞል ከተማ በተካሄደው አመታዊ የላ ቶማቲና ፌስቲቫል ላይ ወደ 20,000 የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ተሳትፈዋል። በበዓሉ ወቅት ተሳታፊዎች 165 ቶን የሚደርስ የበሰበሰ ቲማቲም እርስ በርስ በመወርወር በሙዚቃ ታጅበው ተዝናንተዋል። ከ1945 ጀምሮ የቆየው ይህ ባህላዊ ድግስ፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ታዋቂ የሆነ የቱሪስት መዳረሻ ሆኗል።
oromo: Namoonni 20,000 ol ta'an magaalaa Buñol ispeenitti argamtutti ayyaana La Tomatina waggaa waggaan kabajamu irratti hirmaataniiru. Ayyaana kana irratti, hirmaattonni jiidhaa fi bilchaataa (tomato) toonii 165 ta'u walitti darbachuun muuziqaa waliin gammachuusaanii ibsataniiru. Ayyaanni kun bara 1945 kan jalqabame yoo ta'u, amma addunyaa guutuurraa namoota hedduu harkisuun bakka bashannanaa beekamaa ta'eera.

title: Was Jason Arday really a serial plagiarist? No, the evidence shows
english: Following the death of Cambridge professor Jason Arday, investigations have debunked claims that he was a serial plagiarist or that his academic background was fabricated. While two of his 33 peer-reviewed papers required corrections regarding attribution, the vast majority of his work remained unchallenged and highly cited by his peers. Experts suggest the negative campaign against him was largely unfounded, noting that his contributions to the study of race in education were significant and respected.
amharic: የኬምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ፕሮፌሰር የነበሩት ጄሰን አርዳይ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ከተለዩ በኋላ፣ በእሳቸው ላይ ቀርቦ የነበረው ተደጋጋሚ የማጭበርበር እና የሌላ ሰውን ስራ እንደራስ አድርጎ የማቅረብ ውንጀላ መሰረተ ቢስ ሆኖ ተገኝቷል። በህይወት በነበሩበት ወቅት ካሳተሟቸው 33 የጥናት ወረቀቶች መካከል ሁለቱ ብቻ በምንጭ መጠቀስ ላይ ጥያቄ ተነስቶባቸው እርማት የተደረገባቸው ሲሆን፣ የተቀሩት ግን በምሁራን ዘንድ ትልቅ አድናቆትና ተቀባይነት ነበራቸው። ይህም በፕሮፌሰር አርዳይ ላይ የተደረገው የዘመቻ ጥቃት ትክክል እንዳልነበረ እና በዘር እና በትምህርት ዙሪያ ያበረከቱት አስተዋጽኦ ከፍተኛ እንደነበር ያሳያል።
oromo: Barreessaan Yuunivarsitii Keembridj Piroofeesar Jeeson Ardaay erga du'anii booda, himata isaan irratti dhiyaataa ture kan akka 'heeraa ykn qorannoo namaa hatuu' fi seenaa isaanii sobaan ijaaruu jedhu dhugaa akka hin taane qorannoon mirkaneesseera. Ardaay qorannoo 33 maxxansan keessaa lama qofa irratti rakkoon caqasaa fi qorannoo jiraatuus, hojiin isaanii hedduun garuu fudhatama guddaa qaba ture. Himanni isaan irratti dhiyaate guddina isaanii irratti kan xiyyeeffate malee, hojiin isaanii barnoota fi sanyii irratti xiyyeeffatu kan kabajamaa fi bu'aa qabeessa ta'uu isaa ogeeyyonni ibsaniiru.

title: Iranian president says US will 'achieve nothing' with economic pressure
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian dismissed the latest US economic sanctions, claiming they will not succeed. He stated that his administration has planned strategies to counter these financial pressures. Pezeshkian emphasized that just as past military efforts against Iran failed, current economic tactics will also prove ineffective.
amharic: የኢራኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ማሱድ ፔዜሽኪያን አዲሶቹ የአሜሪካ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦች ምንም ውጤት እንደማይኖራቸው ገልጸዋል። መንግስታቸው እነዚህን የኢኮኖሚ ጫናዎች ለመቋቋም ዝግጅት ማድረጉን ጠቅሰዋል። ቀደም ሲል የተደረጉ ወታደራዊ ጫናዎች ውጤት እንዳልነበራቸው ሁሉ፣ አሁን የተጣሉ ማዕቀቦችም ፋይዳ እንደሌላቸው አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Peezeeshkiyaan, tarkaanfii diinagdee kan Ameerikaan fudhatte bu'aa akka hin qabaanne dubbataniiru. Mootummaan isaanii dhiibbaa diinagdee kana dura dhaabbachuuf karoorfatee akka jiru ibsaniiru. Akkuma waraanni kanaan dura godhame milkaa'ina dhabe, dhiibbaan diinagdee amma godhame kunis kan hin milkoofne ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: German airport worker dies of malaria after 'mosquito arrives on plane'
english: A worker at Frankfurt Airport has died from malaria after contracting the disease from mosquitoes believed to have arrived on an aircraft. In total, six employees were infected by the rare outbreak, and the remaining five are currently undergoing medical treatment. Authorities are investigating the origin of the insects, noting that local transmission of malaria in Germany is extremely unusual.
amharic: በፍራንክፈርት አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ይሠሩ የነበሩ አንድ ሠራተኛ በአውሮፕላን ውስጥ በመጡ ትንኞች አማካኝነት በወባ በሽታ ተይዘው ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። በአጠቃላይ ስድስት ሠራተኞች በዚህ ያልተለመደ የወባ ወረርሽኝ የተያዙ ሲሆን፣ ቀሪዎቹ አምስቱ በሕክምና ላይ ይገኛሉ። ባለሥልጣናት ትንኞቹ ከየት እንደመጡ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በጀርመን ውስጥ እንደዚህ ዓይነት የአካባቢ የወባ ስርጭት እጅግ ያልተለመደ ክስተት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hojjetaan buufata xiyyaaraa Frankfurt tokko dhukkuba busaan du'eera; kunis kan ta'e bookee xiyyaaraan dhufteen erga ciniinameen booda. Walumaagalatti hojjettoonni jahan dhukkubichaan kan qabaman yoo ta'u, shan isaanii ammoo amma yaalamaa jiru. Abbootiin taayitaa bookeewwan kunneen eessaa akka dhufan qorataa jiran yoo ta'u, biyya Jarman keessatti dhukkubni busaa gara namootaatti darbuun kun baay'ee kan nama ajaa'ibu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Radiation link in flight attendant's breast cancer, French court finds
english: A French court has officially recognized that cosmic radiation, along with night shifts and past exposure to secondhand smoke, contributed to a former flight attendant's breast cancer. This landmark ruling allows the worker to access retirement benefits and full medical coverage, setting a legal precedent for future claims from aviation staff. Research indicates that flight crews face a higher risk of radiation-related cancers due to the nature of their work at high altitudes.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ፍርድ ቤት የጠፈር ጨረር፣ የሌሊት ፈረቃ ስራ እና የቀድሞ የሲጋራ ጭስ ተጋላጭነት ለአንድ የቀድሞ የበረራ አስተናጋጅ የጡት ካንሰር መነሻ እንደሆኑ በይፋ አረጋግጧል። ይህ ታሪካዊ ውሳኔ ሰራተኛዋ የጡረታ ጥቅማጥቅሞችን እና የህክምና ወጪዋን ሙሉ በሙሉ እንድታገኝ ያስችላታል። ይህም በሌሎች የበረራ ሰራተኞች የሚነሱ ተመሳሳይ የካሳ ጥያቄዎች እንዲቀበሉ መንገድ ይከፍታል።
oromo: Mana murtii Faransaayi tokko, raadiyeeshinii samii, hojii halkanii fi aarsaa tamboo duraanii, dhukkuba kaansarii harmaa kan hojjettu durii tokko irratti gahee akka qaban murteesseera. Murtiin seena qabeessi kun hojjettuun sun carraa sooramaa fi deeggarsa fayyaa guutuu akka argattu taasisa. Kunis hojjattoota xiyyaaraa biroo kanneen rakkoo walfakkaatu qabanif akka carraa seeraatti kan ilaalamu ta'a.

title: Manchester City sign teenage Moroccan football star Ayyoub Bouaddi
english: Manchester City has officially signed 17-year-old Moroccan midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi from French club Lille for $117 million. The talented teenager, who played a key role in Morocco's 2026 World Cup campaign, signed a five-year contract with the English champions. His move follows an impressive career in France, where he became the youngest player to reach 50 appearances in Ligue 1.
amharic: ማንቸስተር ሲቲ የ17 ዓመቱን የሞሮኮ ብሔራዊ ቡድን አማካይ አዩብ ቡአዲን ከፈረንሳይ ክለብ ሊል በ117 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በይፋ አስፈርሟል። በ2026 የዓለም ዋንጫ ለሞሮኮ ስኬታማ ጉዞ ወሳኝ ሚና የተጫወተው ወጣቱ ተጫዋች፣ ከእንግሊዙ ክለብ ጋር የአምስት ዓመት ውል ተፈራርሟል። ይህ ዝውውር የተፈጸመው በሊግ 1 ከ50 በላይ ጨዋታዎችን በማድረግ በሊጉ ታሪክ ትንሹ ተጫዋች የሆነበትን አስደናቂ ብቃት ካሳየ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Maanchistar Siitii taphataa giddugaleessa biyya Marookoo kan ta'e waggaa 17 Ayyoob Buaadii kilabii Firaansi Liilii irraa doolaara miiliyoona 117n bitateera. Dargaggeessi beekamaan kun kan bara 2026 waancaa addunyaarratti Marookoo gargaare, kilabii Ingilizichaa waliin waliigaltee waggaa shan mallatteesseera. Guddinnii isaa kun erga liigii Firaansi keessatti taphatoota baay'ee xiqqoo ta'ee tapha 50 taphate booda kan raawwatame dha.

title: Germany's Merz warns attackers will 'pay price' after drone incident
english: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has condemned recent drone attacks near Leipzig Airport, vowing that those responsible will face consequences. Investigators discovered explosive-laden drones at the site, which serves as a key hub for military and cargo transport, prompting concerns about rising security threats. While experts suspect Russian involvement, the government has not issued official accusations but plans to strengthen its defenses and continue its strong support for Ukraine.
amharic: የጀርመን ቻንስለር ፍሪድሪች ሜርዝ በሊፕዚግ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ አቅራቢያ የተፈጸሙትን የድሮን ጥቃቶች አውግዘው፣ በኃላፊዎቹ ላይ ተገቢው እርምጃ እንደሚወሰድ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ወታደራዊ እና የጭነት ማጓጓዣ ማዕከል በሆነው በዚህ ስፍራ ፈንጂ የያዙ ድሮኖች መገኘታቸው የጸጥታ ስጋቶችን ጨምሯል። ምንም እንኳን ባለሙያዎች ጥቃቱን ከሩሲያ ጋር ቢያያይዙትም፣ መንግስት እስካሁን ኦፊሴላዊ ክስ አልመሰረተም፤ ሆኖም የአገሪቱን የጸጥታ መዋቅር ለማጠናከር እና ለዩክሬን የሚሰጠውን ድጋፍ ለመቀጠል ወስኗል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Jarman Firedrich Merz buufata xiyyaaraa Leipzig biratti haleellaa xiyyaara malee (drone) gaggeeffame balaaleffachuun, namoonni gocha kana raawwatan itti gaafatamummaa akka fudhatan akeekkachiisaniiru. Buufata xiyyaaraa kana keessatti xiyyaarri meeshaa waraanaa baatte argamuun isaa sodaa nageenyaa guddaa uumee jira. Hayyoonni nageenyaa haleellaa kana keessatti harka Ruusiyaa akka jiru shakkanis, mootummaan hanga ammaatti ifatti qeequu baatus, qophii nageenyaa cimsuufi gargaarsa Yuukreeniif kennamu itti fufuuf murteesseera.

title: Infantino has no future at FIFA, says European Leagues chief
english: Claudius Schaefer, the head of European Leagues, has publicly called for FIFA president Gianni Infantino to step down due to concerns over his leadership and lack of transparency. Critics argue that Infantino makes major decisions without consulting stakeholders and has compromised the integrity of the sport through controversial political interventions. With growing opposition from several major football confederations, the future of the FIFA presidency is now in serious doubt.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ሊጎች ፕሬዚዳንት ክላውዲየስ ሻፈር፣ የፊፋው ፕሬዚዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ በአመራራቸው ላይ ባላቸው ችግር ምክንያት ከኃላፊነታቸው እንዲለቁ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ተቺዎች እንደሚሉት ኢንፋንቲኖ ውሳኔዎችን የሚወስኑት ከባለድርሻ አካላት ጋር ሳይመካከሩ በመሆኑ ለስፖርቱ ገለልተኛነት ስጋት ፈጥረዋል። አሁን ላይ ከበርካታ ዋና ዋና የእግር ኳስ ማህበራት እየቀረበ ባለው ተቃውሞ ሳቢያ የኢንፋንቲኖ የፊፋ ፕሬዚዳንትነት የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ አጠያያቂ ሆኗል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Liigota Awurooppaa Klaawudiyees Shaafar, hooggansi Jiyaanii Infaantiinoo akka gaariitti deemachaa akka hin jirre ibsuun akka aangoo gadhiisan gaafataniiru. Infaantiinoo murtoowwan gurguddoo irratti qaamota dhimmi ilaalu waliin mari'achuu dhiisuun isaanii fi giddu-galummaan siyaasaa isaan ispoortii keessatti godhan amanamummaa FIFA gaaffii keessa galcheera. Yeroo ammaa gamtaa kubbaa miilaa gurguddoo biraa mormiin cimaan irratti ka'aa waan jiruuf, gara fuulduraatti Infaantiinoo hogganaa FIFA ta'anii itti fufuun isaanii shakkiin keessa galeera.

title: China’s Xi to visit Kyrgyzstan, Egypt
english: Chinese President Xi Jinping is scheduled to visit Kyrgyzstan and Egypt between August 30 and September 3. While in Kyrgyzstan, he will participate in the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit to discuss regional issues and bilateral cooperation with member nations. Following this, he will travel to Egypt for a state visit—his first in a decade—to strengthen ties and address regional stability amidst ongoing Middle Eastern conflicts.
amharic: የቻይናው ፕሬዚዳንት ዢ ጂንፒንግ ከኦገስት 30 እስከ ሴፕቴምበር 3 ድረስ በኪርጊስታን እና በግብፅ ይፋዊ ጉብኝት ያደርጋሉ። በኪርጊስታን ቆይታቸው በሻንጋይ ትብብር ድርጅት ጉባኤ ላይ በመገኘት ስለ ቀጠናዊ ጉዳዮች እና ስለ አባል ሀገራት የትብብር ግንኙነት ይመክራሉ። በመቀጠልም በ10 ዓመታት ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ወደ ግብፅ የሚያቀኑት ፕሬዚዳንቱ፣ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር እና በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለውን ሰላም ለመወያየት አቅደዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Chaayinaa Sii Jingpiing Hagayya 30 hanga Fulbaana 3tti biyyoota Kirgistaanii fi Misiriitti imala ni godhu. Kirgistaan keessatti, gumii 'Shanghai Cooperation Organisation' irratti hirmaachuun dhimmoota naannawaa fi walta'iinsa miseensotaa irratti ni mari'atu. Sana booda, waggaa 10 keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf gara Misirii imaluun, hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii cimsuu fi tasgabbii naannichaa irratti mootummaa Misirii waliin marii ni godhu.

title: Is Japan trying to build bridges with China after Taiwan spat?
english: A group of Japanese politicians recently visited Beijing in an attempt to mend diplomatic ties that have severely deteriorated since last year. The friction began when Japan’s leader suggested that a Chinese move against Taiwan could trigger a military response, leading to retaliatory trade restrictions and travel warnings from China. This visit seeks to address the worst bilateral tension in decades, fueled by historical grievances and ongoing disputes over Taiwan's sovereignty.
amharic: የጃፓን የፖለቲካ ልዑካን ቡድን ባለፈው ዓመት በእጅጉ የተበላሸውን የሁለቱን አገራት ግንኙነት ለማሻሻል ቤጂንግን ጎብኝተዋል። ውጥረቱ የተፈጠረው የጃፓን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቻይና በታይዋን ላይ ጥቃት ከሰነዘረች ጃፓን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ልትወስድ ትችላለች በማለታቸው ሲሆን፣ ይህም በቻይና በኩል የንግድ ማዕቀብ እና የጉዞ ማስጠንቀቂያ እንዲጣል ምክንያት ሆኗል። ልዑካኑ ታሪካዊ ቅራኔዎችን እና የታይዋንን ጉዳይ ጨምሮ ለብዙ አሥርተ ዓመታት የቆየውን የሁለቱን አገራት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ አለመግባባት ለመፍታት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Miseensonni siyaasaa Japanii tokko walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaan gidduutti waggaa darbe irraa kaasee hammaate fooyyessuuf gara Beejiing imalaniiru. Walitti bu’iinsi kun kan jalqabe, ministirri muummee Japanii, Chaayinaan Taayiiwaan irratti tarkaanfii fudhatte, Japanii humna waraanaatti fayyadamuu akka dandeessu dubbachuu isaaniitiin booda ture. Kanas hordofee Chaayinaan daangaa daldalaa fi akeekkachiisa imala ishee ergitetti. Imalli kun, walitti bu'iinsa seenaa fi gaaffii abbaa biyyummaa Taayiiwaan irratti hundaa'e furuuf kan kaayyeffatedha.

title: Locarno Film Festival 2026: Palestine, Iran and Gaza's genocide continue to dominate debate
english: The 2026 Locarno Film Festival continued to be a platform for political activism, with the ongoing war in Gaza and regional conflicts in Iran remaining central themes. Despite hopes that the conflict would move out of the spotlight, protesters at the event demanded that the Swiss government take a stronger stance against military aggression. Many filmmakers also used the closing ceremony to voice their support for Palestinians and condemn the humanitarian crisis.
amharic: የ2026 የሎካርኖ ፊልም ፌስቲቫል የፖለቲካ ተሟጋችነት መድረክ ሆኖ የቀጠለ ሲሆን በጋዛ ያለው ጦርነት እና በኢራን የሚታየው ቀውስ የውይይቱ ዋና አጀንዳ ሆነዋል። ግጭቱ ከትኩረት ውጭ ይሆናል ተብሎ ቢጠበቅም በፌስቲቫሉ ላይ የተገኙ ተቃዋሚዎች የስዊዘርላንድ መንግስት በወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች ላይ ጠንካራ አቋም እንዲወስድ ጠይቀዋል። በርካታ የፊልም ባለሙያዎችም የመዝጊያ ስነ-ስርዓቱን በመጠቀም ለፍልስጤማውያን ድጋፋቸውን በመግለጽ የሰብአዊ ቀውሱን አውግዘዋል።
oromo: Ayyaanni fiilmii Locarno kan bara 2026 waldhabdee Gaza fi rakkoo naannoo Iran irratti xiyyeeffannoo guddaa kennee jira. Waraansi kun akka xumuramu abdatamee tureyyu, mormitoonni fiilmii kana irratti argaman mootummaan Siwiizerlaand tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu akka qabu gaafatan. Qopheessitootni fiilmii hedduus guyyaa xumuraa kanatti deeggarsa isaanii warra Falasxiiniif ibsuun balaaleffannaa isaanis dhageessisanii jiru.

title: At least 17 killed as flash flood sweeps part of Nepal-Tibet border
english: A devastating flash flood and mudslide triggered by rapid snowmelt has struck the Nepal-Tibet border, resulting in at least 17 deaths. The disaster destroyed infrastructure and villages, leaving many people missing and cutting off vital road, power, and communication links. Rescue teams are currently working to locate survivors, though efforts are being hindered by difficult weather conditions and damaged terrain.
amharic: በኔፓል እና በቲቤት ድንበር ላይ በረዶ በፍጥነት በመቅለጡ የተከሰተው ከፍተኛ የጎርፍ እና የመሬት መንሸራተት አደጋ ቢያንስ 17 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት ዳርጓል። አደጋው መንደሮችን እና መሠረተ ልማቶችን በማውደሙ ብዙ ሰዎች እንዲጠፉ ያደረገ ሲሆን የመንገድ፣ የኤሌክትሪክ እና የቴሌኮም አገልግሎቶችም ተቋርጠዋል። የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች የተረፉ ሰዎችን ለመፈለግ ጥረት እያደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ አስቸጋሪው የአየር ሁኔታ እና የወደመው የመንገድ ሁኔታ ስራውን አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Daadichi cimaa fi lafti siggiguun cabbii ariitiin baqachuun walqabatee daangaa Neppaalii fi Tiibet gidduutti mudateen lubbuun namoota 17 ol darbeera. Balaan kun gandoota fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa barbadeessuun, namoota hedduu bakka buuteen dhabsiisee akkasumas daandiiwwan, humna ibsaa fi quunnamtii addaan kuteera. Gareewwan fayyisootaa namoota hafan barbaaduuf hojjechaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, haalli qilleensaa fi miidhaan daandiiwwanii carraaqqii isaanii tasgabbii dhabsiisaa jira.

title: Libyan who was cleared after Lockerbie bombing trial dies aged 70
english: Al Amin Khalifah Fhimah, a Libyan man who was acquitted during the 2001 trial for the 1988 Lockerbie bombing, has passed away at age 70. Although he was cleared of charges, he remained a subject of legal interest after new claims surfaced in 2022 suggesting his involvement alongside other intelligence officers. His funeral is scheduled to be held in Tripoli, following a life marked by these serious accusations and his subsequent return to Libya.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ1988 በሎከርቢ የቦምብ ፍንዳታ ወንጀል ተከሶ በ2001 የፍርድ ሂደት ነጻ የተባለው ሊቢያዊው አል አሚን ካሊፋ ፍሂማህ በ70 ዓመቱ አረፈ። ምንም እንኳን በወቅቱ ከክሱ ነጻ ቢወጣም፣ በ2022 የወጡ አዳዲስ መረጃዎች ከሌሎች የሊቢያ የስለላ አባላት ጋር ግንኙነት እንደነበረው በመጠቆሙ በህግ ምርመራ ውስጥ ተጠቅሶ ነበር። የቀብር ስነ ስርዓቱ በሊቢያ ዋና ከተማ ትሪፖሊ እንደሚፈጸም ተገለጿል።
oromo: Namni lammii Liibiyaa Al Amiin Khaliifah Fiimaah jedhamu, kan bara 1988 haleellaa boombii Lokeerbiirratti hirmaate jedhamee himatamee booda bara 2001 bilisa bahe, waggaa 70 tti du'eera. Garaagarummaan himannaa isaa booda illee, bara 2022 ragaan haaraan ka'e tokko miseensota basaastotaa biroo wajjin walitti dhufeenya akka qabu waan eerameef qorannoo seeraa jalatti qabamee ture. Sirni awwaalcha isaa magaalaa guddoo Liibiyaa Tiripoolii keessatti kan raawwatamu ta'uun beekameera.

title: Far-right Israeli lawmaker damages Palestinian memorial with sledgehammer
english: A far-right Israeli lawmaker, Zvi Sukkot, was filmed using a sledgehammer to destroy a Palestinian memorial in the West Bank village of Madama while accompanied by military escorts. The monument honored Palestinians killed in past conflicts, and its destruction has been widely condemned by both Palestinian officials and members of the Israeli government. While the Israeli military provided security for the lawmaker's tour, they claimed the act was unauthorized and eventually removed the group from the area.
amharic: የእስራኤል ፓርላማ አባል የሆኑት ዝቪ ሱኮት በመያዣ ወንዝ ምዕራባዊ ዳርቻ በሚገኘው ማዳማ መንደር የሚገኝ የፍልስጤማውያን መታሰቢያ ሐውልትን በሜንጫ በመምታት አውድመዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በበርካታ ፍልስጤማውያንና እስራኤላውያን ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ የገጠመው ሲሆን፣ በወቅቱ የነበሩት ወታደሮችም በድርጊቱ ላይ ይሁንታ እንዳልነበራቸው ገልጸዋል። የፍልስጤም የድጋፍ መታሰቢያው በ1968 እና በተለያዩ ግጭቶች ህይወታቸውን ያጡ ሰዎችን ለማሰብ የተገነባ መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Miseensi mana maree Israa'el Zvi Sukkot jedhaman, ganda Maadaamaa kan Qarqara Lixaa keessatti yaadannoo Falasxiinotaa gombisuun miidhaa guddaa geessisaniiru. Yaadannoon kun namoota walitti bu'iinsa darbe keessatti du'aniif kan ijaarame yoo ta'u, gochi kun Falasxiinotaa fi qaamolee Israa'el biratti balaaleffannaa jabaa mudateera. Raayyaan Ittisa Israa'el miseensichi yaadannicha akka diiguuf hayyama akka hin qabne beeksisuun, gochaa isaa kana akka mormanii fi bakkeedhichaas akka gadhiisan taasiseera.

title: Indian jewellery ad pulled after backlash over actor's outfit
english: An Indian jewellery brand withdrew a Rakshabandhan advertisement following public criticism regarding Bollywood actor Kriti Sanon's outfit. Critics, including politician Kangana Ranaut, argued the actor's clothing was inappropriate and disrespectful for a traditional Hindu festival. Sanon defended herself against the backlash, stating that personal clothing choices do not define one's respect for cultural traditions.
amharic: የህንድ የጌጣጌጥ ኩባንያ በቅርቡ ለራክሻባንዳን በዓል የለቀቀውን ማስታወቂያ በህዝብ ትችት ምክንያት ከስርጭት ውጭ አድርጓል። ትችት የሰነዘሩት ሰዎች የፊልም ተዋናይዋ ክሪቲ ሳኖን የለበሰችው ልብስ ለባህላዊ በዓሉ ተገቢ እንዳልሆነ በመግለጽ ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል። ተዋናይዋ በበኩሏ የባህል ክብር በልብስ ሳይሆን በልብ ውስጥ የሚገኝ በመሆኑ፣ የልብስ ምርጫ የሰዎችን እሴት እንደማይወስን በመግለጽ ምላሽ ሰጥታለች።
oromo: Kampaniin miidhagoo Indiyaa tokko beeksisa ayyaana 'Rakshabandhan' ilaalchisee baase, uffata aktarri Kriti Saanoon uffatteerratti mormiin erga ka'ee booda akka sirreeffamu taasiseera. Warreen mormii kaasan, uffanni aktarriin kun uffatte ayyaana aadaa kanaaf kan hin taane fi kabaja kan dhabe jedhanii dubbataniiru. Aktarittiin garuu, aadaan uffata irratti kan hundaa'e osoo hin taane, miira fi kabaja namni tokko aadaaf qabu irraa kan madde ta'uu ibsuun mormicha fudhachuu diddeetti.

title: Iran urges Qatar to clarify fate of missing Iranian pilots
english: Iranian officials have requested that Qatar provide more information regarding the status of pilots who went missing after their plane was downed in Qatari territory. The incident took place during the start of a conflict involving the United States, Israel, and Iran. Qatar has stated that it does not currently have any knowledge about what happened to the crew members.
amharic: የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በኳታር አየር ክልል ውስጥ አውሮፕላናቸው ከተመታ በኋላ የጠፉትን አብራሪዎች ሁኔታ እንዲያጣሩ ለኳታር ጥያቄ አቅርበዋል። ይህ ክስተት በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ግጭት በተጀመረበት ወቅት የተከሰተ ነው። ኳታር በበኩሏ ስለ አብራሪዎቹ ዕጣ ፈንታ ምንም አይነት መረጃ እንደሌላት ገልጻለች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Iraan, xiyyaarri isaanii qilleensa Qaatar keessatti erga rukutamee booda kan badanii fiixaan hin beekamne qondaaltota xiyyaaraa sana irratti qulqulleeffannoo akka godhu Qaatar gaafataniiru. Rakkoon kun yeroo waraanni Ameerikaa, Israa'el fi Iraan gidduutti eegaletti kan mudate dha. Qaatar gama ishiitiin, haalli qondaaltota kanaa hanga ammaa akka ishiif hin beekamne ibsiteetti.

title: Iran and Oman plan for temporary Hormuz corridor
english: Iran and Oman are currently discussing plans to create a temporary shipping lane through the Strait of Hormuz to restore safe travel. As part of this initiative, the two countries have agreed to clear the area of underwater mines that have blocked traffic due to recent conflicts. Officials expect to finalize and announce these arrangements for the maritime corridor in the near future.
amharic: ኢራን እና ኦማን በቅርቡ በተፈጠረው ግጭት የተዘጋውን የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ለጊዜው የሚያገለግል የመርከብ መተላለፊያ መንገድ ለመክፈት እየተወያዩ ነው። ሁለቱ አገራት አካባቢውን ከአደጋ ነጻ ለማድረግ ፈንጂዎችን ለማጽዳት ተስማምተዋል። የኦማን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ጉዳዩ በቅርቡ በይፋ እንደሚታወጅ ተስፋቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Iraanii fi Omaan walitti buiinsa kanaan dura ture hordofee cufamee ture, karaa galaana Hormuz yeroof akka banamu mari'achaa jiru. Biyyoonni lamaan kun naannichatti boombiiwwan galaana keessa jiran kaasuun karaa nagaya ta'e uumuuf walii galaniiru. Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Omaan akka ibsanitti, karaa kana banuufi nagaya eeguuf qophiin taasifamaa jiru dhiyeenya kana ifa godhama jedhamee eegama.

title: Israel occupying East Jerusalem UNRWA centre for second day
english: Israeli forces have maintained control over a United Nations relief agency facility in East Jerusalem for a second consecutive day, even raising their national flag at the site. Local authorities report that crews are currently renovating the building to accommodate Israeli students instead of its original humanitarian purpose. The United Nations has strongly criticized this takeover, warning that it severely hinders the organization's ability to fulfill its essential duties.
amharic: የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም የሚገኘውን የተባበሩት መንግስታት የችግኝ ተቋም ለሁለተኛ ቀናቸው ተቆጣጥረው ይገኛሉ። ተቋሙ ለእስራኤል ተማሪዎች አገልግሎት እንዲሰጥ እየተዘጋጀ መሆኑን የገለጹት አካላት፣ በቦታው ላይም የእስራኤል ሰንደቅ ዓላማ መውጣቱን አስታውቀዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ይህ ድርጊት የድርጅቱን ሰብአዊ ተልዕኮ የሚያደናቅፍ መሆኑን በመግለጽ በጥብቅ አውግዟል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'eel bakka dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomaniitti kan ta'e kan Jerusalem Bahaa jiru guyyaa lammaffaaf to'annoo isaanii jala galchanii jiru. Ijaarsa kana barattoota Israa'eel fayyadamuuf akka ta'utti suphuuf hojiin jalqabamee jiraachuun himameera. Mootummoonni Gamtooman garuu tarkaanfii kana balaaleffachuun, hojii gargaarsa dhaabbatichaa irratti gufuu guddaa akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: Netanyahu denounces Iran as 'savages' who cannot be dealt with
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu recently expressed skepticism about the possibility of reaching a diplomatic deal with Iran, describing the country's leadership as savages. During a speech, he voiced his support for the United States' strategy of applying heavy economic pressure on the Iranian government. Netanyahu emphasized that he believes it is impossible to conduct effective negotiations or form agreements with the current regime.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የኢራን መንግሥት አስተዳዳሪዎችን ጨካኞች በማለት በመግለጽ ከእነሱ ጋር በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ መነጋገር እንደማይቻል ገልጸዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የምታደርገውን የኢኮኖሚ ጫና እንደግፋለሁ ብለዋል። አሁን ካለው የኢራን መንግሥት ጋር ማንኛውንም ስምምነት ላይ መድረስ ፈጽሞ የማይቻል መሆኑንም በንግግራቸው አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuun hoggantoonni Iraan warra haala fokkataa keessa jiran ta'uu ibsuun, isaan waliin marii dippilomaasii taasisuun akka hin danda'amne dubbataniiru. Pireezidaantiin Amerikaa mootummaa Iraan irratti dhiibbaa diinagdee cimaa gochuun isaanii sirrii akka ta'e kan deeggaran Netanyaahuun, mootummaa yeroo ammaa waliin waligaltee kamiyyuu uumuun akka hin danda'amne ibsaniiru.

title: Israel seizes UN training centre for Palestinian teens in East Jerusalem
english: Israeli forces led by Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir recently took control of the Qalandiya Vocational Training Institute, the last UN-run facility for Palestinian refugees in East Jerusalem. During the raid, staff were forced to leave the premises, and the Israeli flag was raised at the site. The UN agency, UNRWA, has condemned the move as a violation of international law and its protected status as a humanitarian organization.
amharic: በእስራኤል ብሄራዊ ደህንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪር የሚመሩ ኃይሎች በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም የሚገኘውን የመጨረሻውን የተባበሩት መንግስታት የፍልስጤም ስደተኞች ማሰልጠኛ ተቋም ተቆጣጥረዋል። በዚህ ወረራ ወቅት በስፍራው የነበሩ ሰራተኞች በኃይል እንዲወጡ የተደረጉ ሲሆን የእስራኤል ባንዲራ በግቢው ውስጥ ተተክሏል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ይህ ድርጊት አለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጥስ እና ተቋሙን የሚጠብቁ ህጎችን የጣሰ መሆኑን ገልጾ አውግዟል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el kan ministeera nageenyaa biyyoolessaa Itamar Ben-Gvir hoogganaman, dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniitiin kan bulu kanneen baqattoota Filisxeemii barsiisuuf tajaajilaa ture kan Qalandiyaa to'annaa isaanii jala galchaniiru. Humnoonni kun hojjettoota bakka sanaa humnaan baasuun, alaangaa Israa'el dirree dhaabbatichaa keessatti dhaabaniiru. Dhaabbatichi UNRWA gochi kun seera idil-addunyaa cabsuu fi mirga dhaabbatichaa kan tuqu ta'uu ibsuun balaaleeffateera.

title: One US dollar now costs 2 million rials in Iran, and here’s what it can buy
english: The Iranian rial has plummeted to a record low of 2 million rials per US dollar due to intense international sanctions and the ongoing US-Israel conflict. This economic collapse has caused a sharp increase in the cost of basic necessities like food, medicine, and baby formula. As a result, many families are struggling to afford essential goods, leading to a significant decline in their quality of life.
